            Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String> imagePicker =
            registerForActivityResult(
                    new ActivityResultContracts.GetMultipleContents(),
                    uris -> {
                        if (uris == null || uris.isEmpty()) {
                            return;
                        }

                        selectedImageUris.clear();
                        selectedImageUris.addAll(uris);

                        imagePreview.setImageURI(selectedImageUris.get(0));

                        imageCountText.setText(
                                selectedImageUris.size()
                                        + (selectedImageUris.size() == 1
                                        ? " photo selected"
                                        : " photos selected")
                        );

                        uploadImageButton.setText("Change Selected Photos");

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                selectedImageUris.size() + " photo(s) selected",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show();
                    }
            );

    @Override

        setContentView(R.layout.activity_add_listing);

        locationInput = findViewById(R.id.edtLocation);
        priceInput = findViewById(R.id.edtPrice);

        waterSourceInput = findViewById(R.id.dropdownWaterSource);
        electricityInput = findViewById(R.id.dropdownElectricity);
        sanitationInput = findViewById(R.id.dropdownSanitation);

        imagePreview = findViewById(R.id.imgProperty);
        locationStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvLocationStatus);
        imageCountText = findViewById(R.id.tvSelectedImageCount);
        verifyLocationButton = findViewById(R.id.btnVerifyLocation);
        uploadImageButton = findViewById(R.id.btnUploadImage);
        submitButton = findViewById(R.id.btnSubmitListing);

    private void setupDropdown(
            AutoCompleteTextView dropdown,
            int arrayResource
    ) {
        String[] items = getResources().getStringArray(arrayResource);

        ArrayAdapter<String> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(
                this,
                android.R.layout.simple_dropdown_item_1line,
                items
        );

        dropdown.setAdapter(adapter);
        dropdown.setKeyListener(null);

        dropdown.setOnClickListener(v -> dropdown.showDropDown());

        dropdown.setOnFocusChangeListener((v, hasFocus) -> {
            if (hasFocus) {
                dropdown.showDropDown();
            }
        });
    }

    private void showAmenitiesPickerDialog() {
        String[] options = {
                "Wi-Fi",
                "Parking",
                "Security",
                "Furnished",
                "Water included",
                "Electricity included",
                "Deposit required",
                "No smoking",
                "Shared kitchen",
                "Laundry facilities"
        };

        boolean[] checked = new boolean[options.length];

        for (int i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
            checked[i] = selectedAmenities.contains(options[i]);
        }

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Select Features and Rules")
                .setMultiChoiceItems(
                        options,
                        checked,
                        (dialog, which, isChecked) -> {
                            if (isChecked) {
                                if (!selectedAmenities.contains(options[which])) {
                                    selectedAmenities.add(options[which]);
                                }
                            } else {
                                selectedAmenities.remove(options[which]);
                            }
                        }
                )
                .setPositiveButton("Done", (dialog, which) -> {
                    amenitiesGroup.removeAllViews();

                    for (String amenity : selectedAmenities) {
                        Chip chip = new Chip(this);
                        chip.setText(amenity);
                        chip.setCloseIconVisible(true);
                        chip.setOnCloseIconClickListener(v -> {
                            selectedAmenities.remove(amenity);
                            amenitiesGroup.removeView(chip);
                        });
                        amenitiesGroup.addView(chip);
                    }
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void verifyAddress() {
        String addressText = locationInput.getText()
                .toString()
                .trim();

        if (addressText.isEmpty()) {
            locationInput.setError("Enter the property location first.");
            return;
        }

        verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(false);
        locationStatus.setText("Checking location...");

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                Geocoder geocoder = new Geocoder(
                        AddListingActivity.this,
                        Locale.getDefault()
                );

                List<Address> addresses =
                        geocoder.getFromLocationName(addressText, 1);

                if (addresses != null && !addresses.isEmpty()) {
                    Address address = addresses.get(0);

                    double latitude = address.getLatitude();
                    double longitude = address.getLongitude();

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        verifiedLatitude = latitude;
                        verifiedLongitude = longitude;
                        isLocationVerified = true;

                        locationStatus.setText(
                                "Location verified successfully."
                        );

                        verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(true);
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        isLocationVerified = false;
                        locationStatus.setText(
                                "Location not found. Check the address and try again."
                        );
                        verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(true);
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    isLocationVerified = false;
                    locationStatus.setText(
                            "Could not verify location. Check your connection and try again."
                    );
                    verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(true);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void addListing() {
        String propertyName = propertyNameInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String location = locationInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String priceText = priceInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String roomsText = roomsInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String description = descriptionInput.getText().toString().trim();

        String propertyType = propertyTypeInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String waterSource = waterSourceInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String electricity = electricityInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String sanitation = sanitationInput.getText().toString().trim();

        if (propertyName.isEmpty()
                || location.isEmpty()
                || priceText.isEmpty()
                || roomsText.isEmpty()
                || description.isEmpty()
                || propertyType.isEmpty()
                || waterSource.isEmpty()
                || electricity.isEmpty()
                || sanitation.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please complete all required fields.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        if (!isLocationVerified) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Verify the property location before publishing.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        if (selectedImageUris.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please select at least one property photo.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        double price;
        int rooms;

        try {
            price = Double.parseDouble(priceText);
            rooms = Integer.parseInt(roomsText);
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Enter a valid price and number of rooms.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        if (price <= 0 || rooms <= 0) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Price and rooms must be greater than zero.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Your session has expired. Please log in again.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        submitButton.setEnabled(false);
        uploadImageButton.setEnabled(false);
        verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(false);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                HttpURLConnection connection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                "/rest/v1/listings",
                                "POST",
                                accessToken
                        );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "return=representation"
                );

                JSONObject listing = new JSONObject();
                listing.put("landlord_uid", userId);
                listing.put("property_name", propertyName);
                listing.put("location", location);
                listing.put("price", price);
                listing.put("rooms", rooms);
                listing.put("property_type", propertyType);
                listing.put("description", description);
                listing.put("availability", "Available");

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, listing);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                connection.disconnect();

                if (responseCode < 200 || responseCode >= 300) {
                    Log.e("iKhayaListing", response);
                    showError("Could not create listing. Check your Supabase table permissions.");
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray returned = new JSONArray(response);

                if (returned.length() == 0) {
                    showError("The listing was not returned by Supabase.");
                    return;
                }

                String listingId =
                        returned.getJSONObject(0).getString("id");

                ArrayList<String> uploadedUrls = new ArrayList<>();

                for (int i = 0; i < selectedImageUris.size(); i++) {
                    String imagePath = userId
                            + "/"
                            + listingId
                            + "/property_"
                            + System.currentTimeMillis()
                            + "_"
                            + i
                            + ".jpg";

                    boolean uploaded = uploadImage(
                            accessToken,
                            selectedImageUris.get(i),
                            imagePath
                    );

                    if (!uploaded) {
                        Log.e(
                                "iKhayaImage",
                                "Failed to upload image " + i
                        );
                        continue;
                    }

                    String publicUrl = SupabaseHelper.getPublicStorageUrl(
                            "property-images",
                            imagePath
                    );

                    uploadedUrls.add(publicUrl);

                    saveImageRecord(
                            accessToken,
                            listingId,
                            publicUrl
                    );
                }

                if (uploadedUrls.isEmpty()) {
                    showError(
                            "The listing was created, but no photos uploaded successfully."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                updateListingImagePath(
                        accessToken,
                        listingId,
                        uploadedUrls.get(0)
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    Toast.makeText(
                            AddListingActivity.this,
                            "Listing published with "
                                    + uploadedUrls.size()
                                    + " photo(s).",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                    finish();
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e("iKhayaListing", "Add listing failed", e);
                showError("Error adding listing. Please try again.");
            }
        });
    }

    private boolean uploadImage(
            String accessToken,
            Uri imageUri,
            String imagePath
    ) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createStorageConnection(
                    "property-images",
                    imagePath,
                    "POST",
                    accessToken
            );

            String mimeType = getContentResolver().getType(imageUri);
            if (mimeType == null) {
                mimeType = "image/jpeg";
            }

            connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", mimeType);
            connection.setRequestProperty("x-upsert", "true");
            connection.setDoOutput(true);

            try (InputStream inputStream =
                         getContentResolver().openInputStream(imageUri);
                 OutputStream outputStream = connection.getOutputStream()) {

                if (inputStream == null) {
                    return false;
                }

                byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                int bytesRead;

                while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    outputStream.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
                }

                outputStream.flush();
            }

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            Log.d(
                    "iKhayaImage",
                    "Upload response: " + code + " " + response
            );

            return code >= 200 && code < 300;

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e("iKhayaImage", "Image upload failed", e);
            return false;
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }
    }

    private void saveImageRecord(
            String accessToken,
            String listingId,
            String imageUrl
    ) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                    "/rest/v1/listing_images",
                    "POST",
                    accessToken
            );

            JSONObject record = new JSONObject();
            record.put("listing_id", listingId);
            record.put("image_url", imageUrl);

            SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, record);

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                Log.e("iKhayaImage", "Could not save image record: " + response);
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e("iKhayaImage", "Could not save image record", e);
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }
    }

    private void updateListingImagePath(
            String accessToken,
            String listingId,
            String imageUrl
    ) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                    "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq."
                            + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId),
                    "PATCH",
                    accessToken
            );

            JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
            body.put("image_url", imageUrl);

            SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                Log.e("iKhayaListing", "Image URL update failed: " + response);
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e("iKhayaListing", "Could not update image URL", e);
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }
    }

    private void showError(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            submitButton.setEnabled(true);
            uploadImageButton.setEnabled(true);
            verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(true);

            Toast.makeText(
                    AddListingActivity.this,
                    message,
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminActiveListingAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AdminActiveListingAdapter.ViewHolder> {

    public interface OnListingRevokedListener {
        void onListingRevoked();
    }

    private final Context context;
    private final List<AdminListing> activeListings;
    private final OnListingRevokedListener listener;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    public AdminActiveListingAdapter(Context context, List<AdminListing> activeListings, OnListingRevokedListener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.activeListings = activeListings;
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        // Reuse the same layout, we will modify the buttons programmatically
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_admin_listing, parent, false);
        return new ViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        AdminListing listing = activeListings.get(position);

        holder.tvListingTitle.setText(listing.getTitle());
        holder.tvListingDetails.setText(listing.getDetails());
        holder.tvLandlordInfo.setText("Submitted by: " + listing.getLandlordName());

        // HIDE the Approve Button and Rename Reject to REVOKE
        holder.btnApproveListing.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        holder.btnRejectListing.setText("REVOKE");

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent intent = new Intent(context, AdminInspectionActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listing.getId());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_TITLE", listing.getTitle());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_DETAILS", listing.getDetails());
            intent.putExtra("LANDLORD_NAME", listing.getLandlordName());
            intent.putExtra("IMAGE_URL", listing.getImageUrl());
            context.startActivity(intent);
        });

        holder.btnRejectListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            EditText input = new EditText(context);
            input.setHint("e.g., Reported as a scam, invalid details");
            input.setPadding(40, 40, 40, 40);

            new AlertDialog.Builder(context)
                    .setTitle("Revoke Live Listing")
                    .setMessage("Pull '" + listing.getTitle() + "' offline immediately? Provide a reason:")
                    .setView(input)
                    .setPositiveButton("Revoke", (dialog, which) -> {
                        String reason = input.getText().toString().trim();
                        if (reason.isEmpty()) {
                            Toast.makeText(context, "Reason required to revoke a listing.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            return;
                        }
                        revokeListing(listing, reason, holder.getBindingAdapterPosition());
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show();
        });
    }

    private void revokeListing(AdminListing listing, String reason, int position) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(context);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + listing.getId().trim();
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", "REJECTED");
                body.put("availability", "Rejected");
                body.put("rejection_reason", "ADMIN REVOKED: " + reason);

                SupabaseHelper.patch(endpoint, body, token);

                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (position >= 0 && position < activeListings.size()) {
                        activeListings.remove(position);
                        notifyItemRemoved(position);
                        notifyItemRangeChanged(position, activeListings.size());
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Listing revoked and pulled offline.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    AnalyticsHelper.logAdminAction(context, "revoked", listing.getTitle());
                    if (listener != null) listener.onListingRevoked();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> Toast.makeText(context, "Revoke failed: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return activeListings.size();
    }

    public static class ViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        TextView tvListingTitle, tvListingDetails, tvLandlordInfo;
        Button btnRejectListing, btnApproveListing;

        public ViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            tvListingTitle = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingTitle);
            tvListingDetails = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingDetails);
            tvLandlordInfo = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLandlordInfo);
            btnRejectListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnRejectListing);
            btnApproveListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnApproveListing);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;

public class AdminActiveListingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity implements AdminActiveListingAdapter.OnListingRevokedListener {

    private RecyclerView rvActiveListings;
    private AdminActiveListingAdapter listingAdapter;

    private final List<AdminListing> masterQueue = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AdminListing> displayedQueue = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditText etSearchActive;
    private TextView tvEmptyActive;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_active_listings);

        ImageButton btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

    private void setupSearch() {
        etSearchActive.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                applySearch(s.toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
    }

    private void applySearch(String query) {
        String lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        displayedQueue.clear();

        for (AdminListing listing : masterQueue) {
            if (listing.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getLandlordName().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getDetails().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery)) {
                displayedQueue.add(listing);
            }
        }

        listingAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();

        if (displayedQueue.isEmpty()) {
            rvActiveListings.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            tvEmptyActive.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        } else {
            rvActiveListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            tvEmptyActive.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private void loadActiveListings() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?select=id,property_name,price,location,landlord_uid,status,image_url"
                        + "&status=ilike.APPROVED&order=created_at.desc";

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<AdminListing> fetched = new ArrayList<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                        String id = obj.optString("id", "");
                        String name = obj.optString("property_name", "Untitled Listing");
                        String price = obj.optString("price", "0");
                        String loc = obj.optString("location", "No location");
                        String landlordUid = obj.optString("landlord_uid", "");
                        String status = obj.optString("status", "APPROVED");
                        String imageUrl = obj.optString("image_url", "");

                        String details = loc + " â€¢ R " + price + " / month";
                        String landlordLabel = landlordUid.length() > 8 ? "Landlord (" + landlordUid.substring(0, 8) + "...)" : "Landlord";

                        fetched.add(new AdminListing(id, name, details, landlordUid, landlordLabel, status, imageUrl));
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        masterQueue.clear();
                        masterQueue.addAll(fetched);
                        applySearch(etSearchActive.getText().toString());
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, "Error loading queue: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void onListingRevoked() {
        loadActiveListings();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void loadAllDashboardCounts() {
        loadPendingCount();
        loadActiveCount();
        loadLiveUsersCount();
    }

    private void loadPendingCount() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/listings?select=id&status=ilike.PENDING", "GET", token);
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    pendingCount = arr.length();
                    runOnUiThread(this::updateAggregatedMetrics);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error fetching pending listings", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadActiveCount() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/listings?select=id&status=ilike.APPROVED", "GET", token);
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    activeCount = arr.length();
                    runOnUiThread(this::updateAggregatedMetrics);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error fetching active listings", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadLiveUsersCount() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/profiles?select=firebase_uid", "GET", token);
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    Set<String> uniqueIds = new HashSet<>();
                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        String uid = arr.getJSONObject(i).optString("firebase_uid", "");
                        if (!uid.isEmpty()) uniqueIds.add(uid);
                    }
                    final int count = uniqueIds.size();
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (tvStatUsers != null) tvStatUsers.setText(String.valueOf(count));
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error fetching user counts", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void updateAggregatedMetrics() {
        if (tvStatPending != null) tvStatPending.setText(String.valueOf(pendingCount));
        if (tvStatActive != null) tvStatActive.setText(String.valueOf(activeCount));

        int totalProperties = pendingCount + activeCount;
        if (tvStatTotalProperties != null) {
            tvStatTotalProperties.setText(String.valueOf(totalProperties));
        }

        if (totalProperties > 0) {
            int rate = (int) Math.round(((double) activeCount / totalProperties) * 100);
            if (pbApprovalRatio != null) pbApprovalRatio.setProgress(rate);
            if (tvClearancePercent != null) tvClearancePercent.setText(rate + "%");
        } else {
            if (pbApprovalRatio != null) pbApprovalRatio.setProgress(100);
            if (tvClearancePercent != null) tvClearancePercent.setText("100%");
        }
    }

    private void performLogout() {
        // Clear cached Supabase credentials
        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);
        prefs.edit().clear().apply();

        // Redirect to LoginActivity and clear back stack
        Intent intent = new Intent(this, LoginActivity.class);
        intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        startActivity(intent);
        finish();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\AdminListingAdapter.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminListingAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AdminListingAdapter.ViewHolder> {

    public interface OnListingActionListener {
        void onListingActionTaken();
    }

    private final Context context;
    private final List<AdminListing> pendingListings;
    private final OnListingActionListener actionListener;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    public AdminListingAdapter(Context context, List<AdminListing> pendingListings, OnListingActionListener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.pendingListings = pendingListings;
        this.actionListener = listener;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_admin_listing, parent, false);
        return new ViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        AdminListing listing = pendingListings.get(position);

        holder.tvListingTitle.setText(listing.getTitle());
        holder.tvListingDetails.setText(listing.getDetails());
        holder.tvLandlordInfo.setText("Submitted by: " + listing.getLandlordName());

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent intent = new Intent(context, AdminInspectionActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listing.getId());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_TITLE", listing.getTitle());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_DETAILS", listing.getDetails());
            intent.putExtra("LANDLORD_NAME", listing.getLandlordName());
            intent.putExtra("IMAGE_URL", listing.getImageUrl());
            context.startActivity(intent);
        });

        holder.btnApproveListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            new AlertDialog.Builder(context)
                    .setTitle("Approve Listing")
                    .setMessage("Approve '" + listing.getTitle() + "' to go live on the platform?")
                    .setPositiveButton("Yes, Approve", (dialog, which) -> {
                        updateListingStatus(listing, "APPROVED", null, holder.getBindingAdapterPosition());
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show();
        });

        holder.btnRejectListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            EditText input = new EditText(context);
            input.setHint("e.g., Unclear photos, incorrect address, misleading price");
            input.setPadding(40, 40, 40, 40);

            new AlertDialog.Builder(context)
                    .setTitle("Reject Listing")
                    .setMessage("Please provide a reason for rejecting '" + listing.getTitle() + "':")
                    .setView(input)
                    .setPositiveButton("Reject", (dialog, which) -> {
                        String reason = input.getText().toString().trim();
                        if (reason.isEmpty()) {
                            Toast.makeText(context, "A reason is required to reject a listing.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            return;
                        }
                        updateListingStatus(listing, "REJECTED", reason, holder.getBindingAdapterPosition());
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show();
        });
    }

    private void updateListingStatus(AdminListing listing, String newStatus, String reason, int position) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(context);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + listing.getId().trim();

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", newStatus);
                body.put("availability", "APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(newStatus) ? "Available" : "Rejected");
                if (reason != null && !reason.isEmpty()) {
                    body.put("rejection_reason", reason);
                }

                // Native OkHttp PATCH
                SupabaseHelper.patch(endpoint, body, token);

                if ("REJECTED".equalsIgnoreCase(newStatus) && listing.getLandlordUid() != null && !listing.getLandlordUid().isEmpty()) {
                    sendRejectionNotification(token, listing.getLandlordUid(), listing.getTitle(), reason);
                }

                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (position >= 0 && position < pendingListings.size()) {
                        pendingListings.remove(position);
                        notifyItemRemoved(position);
                        notifyItemRangeChanged(position, pendingListings.size());
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Listing " + newStatus.toLowerCase() + " successfully.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    AnalyticsHelper.logAdminAction(context, newStatus.toLowerCase(), listing.getTitle());
                    if (actionListener != null) {
                        actionListener.onListingActionTaken();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> Toast.makeText(context, "Update failed: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
            }
        });
    }

    private void sendRejectionNotification(String token, String landlordUid, String propertyTitle, String reason) {
        HttpURLConnection conn = null;
        try {
            conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/notifications", "POST", token);
            conn.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");

            JSONObject notif = new JSONObject();
            notif.put("user_uid", landlordUid);
            notif.put("title", "Listing Rejected: " + propertyTitle);
            notif.put("message", "Your accommodation submission was rejected. Reason: " + reason);

            SupabaseHelper.writeJson(conn, notif);
            conn.getResponseCode();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return pendingListings.size();
    }

    public static class ViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        TextView tvListingTitle, tvListingDetails, tvLandlordInfo;
        Button btnRejectListing, btnApproveListing;

        public ViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            tvListingTitle = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingTitle);
            tvListingDetails = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingDetails);
            tvLandlordInfo = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLandlordInfo);
            btnRejectListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnRejectListing);
            btnApproveListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnApproveListing);
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\AdminPendingQueueActivity.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminPendingQueueActivity extends AppCompatActivity implements AdminListingAdapter.OnListingActionListener {

    private RecyclerView rvPendingQueue;
    private AdminListingAdapter listingAdapter;

    private final List<AdminListing> masterQueue = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AdminListing> displayedQueue = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditText etSearchListings;
    private Button btnSortNewest, btnSortOldest;
    private TextView tvEmptyQueue;

    private boolean isSortNewest = true;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_pending_queue);

        ImageButton btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        etSearchListings = findViewById(R.id.etSearchListings);
        btnSortNewest = findViewById(R.id.btnSortNewest);
        btnSortOldest = findViewById(R.id.btnSortOldest);
        tvEmptyQueue = findViewById(R.id.tvEmptyQueue);

        rvPendingQueue = findViewById(R.id.rvPendingQueue);
        rvPendingQueue.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));

        listingAdapter = new AdminListingAdapter(this, displayedQueue, this);
        rvPendingQueue.setAdapter(listingAdapter);

        setupSorters();
        setupSearch();
        loadPendingQueue();
    }

    private void setupSorters() {
        btnSortNewest.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            isSortNewest = true;
            updateSortUI();
            applySearchAndSort(etSearchListings.getText().toString());
        });

        btnSortOldest.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            isSortNewest = false;
            updateSortUI();
            applySearchAndSort(etSearchListings.getText().toString());
        });
    }

    private void updateSortUI() {
        btnSortNewest.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor(isSortNewest ? "#5E72E4" : "#E9ECEF")));
        btnSortNewest.setTextColor(Color.parseColor(isSortNewest ? "#FFFFFF" : "#32325D"));

        btnSortOldest.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor(!isSortNewest ? "#5E72E4" : "#E9ECEF")));
        btnSortOldest.setTextColor(Color.parseColor(!isSortNewest ? "#FFFFFF" : "#32325D"));
    }

    private void setupSearch() {
        etSearchListings.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                applySearchAndSort(s.toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
    }

    private void applySearchAndSort(String query) {
        String lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        displayedQueue.clear();

        // Filter
        for (AdminListing listing : masterQueue) {
            if (listing.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getLandlordName().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getDetails().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery)) {
                displayedQueue.add(listing);
            }
        }

        // Sort (Assuming masterQueue is fetched descending by default)
        if (!isSortNewest) {
            Collections.reverse(displayedQueue);
        }

        listingAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();

        if (displayedQueue.isEmpty()) {
            rvPendingQueue.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            tvEmptyQueue.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        } else {
            rvPendingQueue.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            tvEmptyQueue.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private void loadPendingQueue() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                // Fetch ordered descending by default
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?select=id,property_name,price,location,landlord_uid,status,image_url"
                        + "&status=ilike.PENDING&order=created_at.desc";

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<AdminListing> fetched = new ArrayList<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                        String id = obj.optString("id", "");
                        String name = obj.optString("property_name", "Untitled Listing");
                        String price = obj.optString("price", "0");
                        String loc = obj.optString("location", "No location");
                        String landlordUid = obj.optString("landlord_uid", "");
                        String status = obj.optString("status", "PENDING");
                        String imageUrl = obj.optString("image_url", "");

                        String details = loc + " â€¢ R " + price + " / month";
                        String landlordLabel = landlordUid.length() > 8 ? "Landlord (" + landlordUid.substring(0, 8) + "...)" : "Landlord";

                        fetched.add(new AdminListing(id, name, details, landlordUid, landlordLabel, status, imageUrl));
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        masterQueue.clear();
                        masterQueue.addAll(fetched);
                        applySearchAndSort(etSearchListings.getText().toString());
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, "Error loading queue: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void onListingActionTaken() {
        // Automatically reload the queue when an item is approved/rejected
        loadPendingQueue();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminReportsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private LinearLayout reportsContainer;
    private ProgressBar progressReports;
    private TextView tvEmptyReports;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_reports);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        progressReports = findViewById(R.id.progressReports);
        tvEmptyReports = findViewById(R.id.tvEmptyReports);

    private void loadReports() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Please log in again.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }

        if (progressReports != null) {
            progressReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/reports?select=*&order=created_at.desc", "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (progressReports != null) progressReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        displayReports(arr);
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (progressReports != null) progressReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    });
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (progressReports != null) progressReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                });
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void displayReports(JSONArray arr) {
        if (reportsContainer == null) return;
        reportsContainer.removeAllViews();

        if (arr.length() == 0) {
            if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return;
        }

        if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            try {
                JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                addReportCard(obj, i);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }
    }

    private void addReportCard(JSONObject obj, int position) {
        String ticketId = obj.optString("id", "");
        String reporterUid = obj.optString("reporter_uid", "");
        String reporterName = obj.optString("reporter_name", "User");
        String reporterRole = obj.optString("reporter_role", "Member");
        String reason = obj.optString("reason", "Support Ticket");
        String description = obj.optString("description", "No description provided");
        String status = obj.optString("status", "OPEN");

        CardView card = new CardView(this);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams cardParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        );
        cardParams.setMargins(0, 0, 0, 24);
        card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);
        card.setRadius(24f);
        card.setCardElevation(4f);
        card.setCardBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE);

        LinearLayout layout = new LinearLayout(this);
        layout.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        layout.setPadding(32, 28, 32, 28);

        TextView tvReason = new TextView(this);
        tvReason.setText(reason);
        tvReason.setTextSize(16f);
        tvReason.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        tvReason.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BA5536"));

        TextView tvReporter = new TextView(this);
        tvReporter.setText("By: " + reporterName + " (" + reporterRole.toUpperCase() + ")");
        tvReporter.setTextSize(12f);
        tvReporter.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));

        TextView tvDesc = new TextView(this);
        tvDesc.setText(description);
        tvDesc.setTextSize(14f);
        tvDesc.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
        tvDesc.setPadding(0, 12, 0, 12);

        TextView tvStatus = new TextView(this);
        tvStatus.setText("Status: " + status);
        tvStatus.setTextSize(12f);
        tvStatus.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));

        layout.addView(tvReason);
        layout.addView(tvReporter);
        layout.addView(tvDesc);
        layout.addView(tvStatus);

        // Action Buttons Row
        LinearLayout actionRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        actionRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        actionRow.setPadding(0, 16, 0, 0);

        Button btnResolve = new Button(this);
        btnResolve.setText("Resolve");
        btnResolve.setOnClickListener(v -> showResponseDialog(ticketId, "RESOLVED", "Resolution Message", card));
        actionRow.addView(btnResolve);

        Button btnDismiss = new Button(this);
        btnDismiss.setText("Dismiss");
        btnDismiss.setOnClickListener(v -> showResponseDialog(ticketId, "DISMISSED", "Reason for Dismissal", card));
        actionRow.addView(btnDismiss);

        layout.addView(actionRow);
        card.addView(layout);

        reportsContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private void showResponseDialog(String ticketId, String newStatus, String prompt, View cardView) {
        EditText input = new EditText(this);
        input.setHint("Enter response to the user");

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(prompt)
                .setView(input)
                .setPositiveButton("Submit", (dialog, which) -> {
                    String responseText = input.getText().toString().trim();
                    updateTicketStatus(ticketId, newStatus, responseText, cardView);
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void updateTicketStatus(String ticketId, String newStatus, String adminResponse, View cardView) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        if (token == null || ticketId.isEmpty()) return;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                JSONObject patchBody = new JSONObject();
                patchBody.put("status", newStatus);
                patchBody.put("admin_response", adminResponse);

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/reports?id=eq." + ticketId,
                        "PATCH",
                        token
                );
                conn.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");
                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(conn, patchBody);

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Ticket marked as " + newStatus, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        if (reportsContainer != null) {
                            reportsContainer.removeView(cardView);
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() ->
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to update ticket (HTTP " + code + ")", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    );
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() ->
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Error connecting to server", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                );
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminUserAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AdminUserAdapter.ViewHolder> {

    private final Context context;
    private final List<AdminUser> users;
    private final String currentAdminId;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    public AdminUserAdapter(Context context, List<AdminUser> users, String currentAdminId) {
        this.context = context;
        this.users = users;
        this.currentAdminId = currentAdminId == null ? "" : currentAdminId;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_admin_user, parent, false);
        return new ViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        AdminUser user = users.get(position);
        holder.tvUserName.setText(user.getName());
        holder.tvUserRole.setText(user.getRole().toUpperCase());

        // Anti-Self-Destruction Check
        if (user.getUserId().equals(currentAdminId)) {
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setText("YOU");
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#6C757D")); // Gray disabled color
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(false);
            holder.tvUserName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#5E72E4")); // Highlight own name in blue
            return; // Skip attaching the click listener entirely
        }

        holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(true);
        updateButtonUI(holder, user.isSuspended());

        holder.btnSuspendUser.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            boolean targetState = !user.isSuspended();
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(false);

            String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(context);

            executor.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    String endpoint = "/rest/v1/profiles?firebase_uid=eq." + user.getUserId().trim();

                    JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                    body.put("is_suspended", targetState);

                    SupabaseHelper.patch(endpoint, body, token);

                    mainHandler.post(() -> {
                        user.setSuspended(targetState);
                        holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(true);
                        updateButtonUI(holder, targetState);
                        Toast.makeText(context, user.getName() + " account " + (targetState ? "suspended" : "reactivated"), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    });

                } catch (Exception e) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> {
                        holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(true);
                        Toast.makeText(context, "Account update failed: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void updateButtonUI(ViewHolder holder, boolean isSuspended) {
        if (isSuspended) {
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setText("Unsuspend");
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#28A745")); // Green
            holder.tvUserName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#DC3545")); // Red text
        } else {
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setText("Suspend");
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#DC3545")); // Red
            holder.tvUserName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#212529")); // Default dark text
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return users.size();
    }

    public static class ViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        TextView tvUserName, tvUserRole;
        Button btnSuspendUser;

        public ViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            tvUserName = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvUserName);
            tvUserRole = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvUserRole);
            btnSuspendUser = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnSuspendUser);
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\AdminUsersActivity.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminUsersActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private RecyclerView rvUserDirectory;
    private AdminUserAdapter userAdapter;

    private final List<AdminUser> masterUserList = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AdminUser> displayedUsers = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditText etSearchUsers;
    private Button btnFilterAll, btnFilterTenants, btnFilterLandlords, btnFilterSuspended;
    private String currentFilter = "ALL";
    private String currentAdminId = "";

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_users);

        // Get the logged in admin's UID to prevent self-destruction
        currentAdminId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        ImageButton btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        etSearchUsers = findViewById(R.id.etSearchUsers);
        btnFilterAll = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterAll);
        btnFilterTenants = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterTenants);
        btnFilterLandlords = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterLandlords);
        btnFilterSuspended = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterSuspended);

        rvUserDirectory = findViewById(R.id.rvUserDirectory);
        rvUserDirectory.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));

        // Pass the current admin ID to the adapter
        userAdapter = new AdminUserAdapter(this, displayedUsers, currentAdminId);
        rvUserDirectory.setAdapter(userAdapter);

        setupFilters();
        setupSearch();
        loadAllUsers();
    }

    private void setupFilters() {
        btnFilterAll.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("ALL", btnFilterAll));
        btnFilterTenants.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("TENANT", btnFilterTenants));
        btnFilterLandlords.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("LANDLORD", btnFilterLandlords));
        btnFilterSuspended.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("SUSPENDED", btnFilterSuspended));
    }

    private void applyFilter(String filterType, Button selectedButton) {
        currentFilter = filterType;

        Button[] allButtons = {btnFilterAll, btnFilterTenants, btnFilterLandlords, btnFilterSuspended};
        for (Button btn : allButtons) {
            btn.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor("#E9ECEF")));
            btn.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#32325D"));
        }

        selectedButton.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor("#5E72E4")));
        selectedButton.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);

        applySearchAndFilter(etSearchUsers.getText().toString());
    }

    private void setupSearch() {
        etSearchUsers.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                applySearchAndFilter(s.toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
    }

    private void applySearchAndFilter(String query) {
        String lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        displayedUsers.clear();

        AdminUser me = null;
        List<AdminUser> others = new ArrayList<>();

        for (AdminUser user : masterUserList) {
            boolean matchesSearch = user.getName().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery);
            boolean matchesFilter = false;

            switch (currentFilter) {
                case "ALL":
                    matchesFilter = true;
                    break;
                case "TENANT":
                    matchesFilter = "tenant".equalsIgnoreCase(user.getRole());
                    break;
                case "LANDLORD":
                    matchesFilter = "landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(user.getRole());
                    break;
                case "SUSPENDED":
                    matchesFilter = user.isSuspended();
                    break;
            }

            if (matchesSearch && matchesFilter) {
                // Partition the current admin from the rest of the list
                if (user.getUserId().equals(currentAdminId)) {
                    me = user;
                } else {
                    others.add(user);
                }
            }
        }

        // Always put the current admin at the very top if they match the filter criteria
        if (me != null) displayedUsers.add(me);
        displayedUsers.addAll(others);

        userAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private void loadAllUsers() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/profiles?select=firebase_uid,full_name,role,is_suspended&order=created_at.desc", "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray profilesArr = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<AdminUser> fetchedUsers = new ArrayList<>();
                    Set<String> seenIds = new HashSet<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < profilesArr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject obj = profilesArr.getJSONObject(i);
                        String uid = obj.optString("firebase_uid", "");
                        String name = obj.optString("full_name", "User");
                        String role = obj.optString("role", "tenant");
                        boolean suspended = obj.optBoolean("is_suspended", false);

                        if (!uid.isEmpty() && !seenIds.contains(uid)) {
                            seenIds.add(uid);
                            fetchedUsers.add(new AdminUser(uid, name, role, suspended));
                        }
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        masterUserList.clear();
                        masterUserList.addAll(fetchedUsers);
                        applySearchAndFilter(etSearchUsers.getText().toString());
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, "Error loading users: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Bundle;
import com.google.firebase.analytics.FirebaseAnalytics;

public class AnalyticsHelper {

    private static FirebaseAnalytics mFirebaseAnalytics;

    public static void init(Context context) {
        if (mFirebaseAnalytics == null) {
            mFirebaseAnalytics = FirebaseAnalytics.getInstance(context);
        }
    }

    public static void logLogin(Context context, String role) {
        init(context);
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();
        bundle.putString("user_role", role);
        bundle.putString(FirebaseAnalytics.Param.METHOD, "Supabase");
        mFirebaseAnalytics.logEvent(FirebaseAnalytics.Event.LOGIN, bundle);
    }

    public static void logAdminAction(Context context, String actionType, String propertyTitle) {
        init(context);
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();
        bundle.putString("action_type", actionType); // e.g., "approved", "rejected", "revoked"
        bundle.putString("property", propertyTitle);
        mFirebaseAnalytics.logEvent("admin_moderation", bundle);
    }
}
