package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

public class ApplicationManager {

    private static final String PREF_NAME = "ikhaya_applications_pref";
    private static final String KEY_APPS = "applications_json_list";
    private static final String KEY_SEEN_APPROVED =
            "seen_approved_application_ids";

    public static class RentalApplication {

        public String id;
        public String propertyTitle;
        public String applicantName;
        public String phone;
        public String emergencyContact;
        public String occupation;
        public String moveInDate;
        public String leaseDuration;
        public String occupants;
        public String rentalPrice;
        public String note;
        public String status;

        public RentalApplication(
                String id,
                String propertyTitle,
                String applicantName,
                String phone,
                String emergencyContact,
                String occupation,
                String moveInDate,
                String leaseDuration,
                String occupants,
                String rentalPrice,
                String note,
                String status) {

            this.id = id;
            this.propertyTitle = propertyTitle;
            this.applicantName = applicantName;
            this.phone = phone;
            this.emergencyContact = emergencyContact;
            this.occupation = occupation;
            this.moveInDate = moveInDate;
            this.leaseDuration = leaseDuration;
            this.occupants = occupants;
            this.rentalPrice = rentalPrice;
            this.note = note;
            this.status = status;
        }

        public JSONObject toJson() {
            JSONObject obj = new JSONObject();

            try {
                obj.put("id", id);
                obj.put("propertyTitle", propertyTitle);
                obj.put("applicantName", applicantName);
                obj.put("phone", phone);
                obj.put("emergencyContact", emergencyContact);
                obj.put("occupation", occupation);
                obj.put("moveInDate", moveInDate);
                obj.put("leaseDuration", leaseDuration);
                obj.put("occupants", occupants);
                obj.put("rentalPrice", rentalPrice);
                obj.put("note", note);
                obj.put("status", status);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            return obj;
        }

        public static RentalApplication fromJson(JSONObject obj) {
            return new RentalApplication(
                    obj.optString("id", ""),
                    obj.optString("propertyTitle", "Property"),
                    obj.optString("applicantName", "Tenant"),
                    obj.optString("phone", ""),
                    obj.optString("emergencyContact", ""),
                    obj.optString("occupation", ""),
                    obj.optString("moveInDate", ""),
                    obj.optString("leaseDuration", ""),
                    obj.optString("occupants", "1"),
                    obj.optString("rentalPrice", "R0"),
                    obj.optString("note", ""),
                    obj.optString("status", "PENDING")
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns all rental applications saved on this device.
     */
    public static List<RentalApplication> getApplications(Context context) {
        List<RentalApplication> applications = new ArrayList<>();

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREF_NAME,
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String raw = prefs.getString(KEY_APPS, "[]");

        try {
            JSONArray array = new JSONArray(raw);

            for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject obj = array.optJSONObject(i);

                if (obj != null) {
                    applications.add(RentalApplication.fromJson(obj));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        return applications;
    }

    /**
     * Saves a new rental application at the beginning of the list.
     */
    public static void addApplication(
            Context context,
            RentalApplication application) {

        if (application == null) {
            return;
        }

        List<RentalApplication> applications =
                getApplications(context);

        applications.add(0, application);
        saveList(context, applications);
    }

    /**
     * Updates an application's status without removing its other details.
     * Example statuses: PENDING, APPROVED, DECLINED.
     */
    public static void updateStatus(
            Context context,
            String id,
            String newStatus) {

        if (id == null || newStatus == null) {
            return;
        }

        List<RentalApplication> applications =
                getApplications(context);

        for (RentalApplication application : applications) {
            if (application.id != null
                    && application.id.equals(id)) {

                application.status = newStatus.trim().toUpperCase();
                break;
            }
        }

        saveList(context, applications);
    }

    /**
     * Counts applications that are still waiting for the landlord's decision.
     */
    public static int getPendingCount(Context context) {
        int count = 0;

        for (RentalApplication application : getApplications(context)) {
            if ("PENDING".equalsIgnoreCase(application.status)) {
                count++;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }

    /**
     * Counts approved applications that the resident has not yet viewed
     * on this device.
     */
    public static int getUnseenApprovedCount(Context context) {
        Set<String> seenIds = getSeenApprovedIds(context);
        int count = 0;

        for (RentalApplication application : getApplications(context)) {
            if ("APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(application.status)
                    && hasValidId(application.id)
                    && !seenIds.contains(application.id)) {
                count++;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }

    /**
     * Marks all currently approved applications as seen.
     */
    public static void markApprovedApplicationsSeen(Context context) {
        Set<String> seenIds = getSeenApprovedIds(context);

        for (RentalApplication application : getApplications(context)) {
            if ("APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(application.status)
                    && hasValidId(application.id)) {
                seenIds.add(application.id);
            }
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .edit()
                .putStringSet(KEY_SEEN_APPROVED, seenIds)
                .apply();
    }

    /**
     * Clears the approved-application viewed state.
     * Use only if the app intentionally needs to reset these notifications.
     */
    public static void clearSeenApprovedApplications(Context context) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .edit()
                .remove(KEY_SEEN_APPROVED)
                .apply();
    }

    private static Set<String> getSeenApprovedIds(Context context) {
        Set<String> saved = context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .getStringSet(KEY_SEEN_APPROVED, null);

        if (saved == null) {
            return new HashSet<>();
        }

        // Copy the saved set before changing it.
        return new HashSet<>(saved);
    }

    private static boolean hasValidId(String id) {
        return id != null && !id.trim().isEmpty();
    }

    private static void saveList(
            Context context,
            List<RentalApplication> applications) {

        JSONArray array = new JSONArray();

        for (RentalApplication application : applications) {
            array.put(application.toJson());
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .edit()
                .putString(KEY_APPS, array.toString())
                .apply();
    }
}

    private void loadApplications() {
        String uid = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty()
                || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    R.string.please_log_in_again,
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        applicationsContainer.removeAllViews();
        txtNoApplications.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        txtNoApplications.setText(
                R.string.rental_applications_loading
        );

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String field = isLandlordView
                        ? "landlord_uid"
                        : "tenant_uid";

                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/rental_applications?select=*"
                                + "&" + field + "=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(uid)
                                + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint, "GET", token
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    throw new Exception(
                            "HTTP " + code + ": " + response
                    );
                }

                JSONArray rows = new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    txtNoApplications.setVisibility(
                            rows.length() == 0
                                    ? View.VISIBLE
                                    : View.GONE
                    );

                    txtNoApplications.setText(
                            R.string.no_applications_yet
                    );

                    for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

                        if (row != null) {
                            renderCard(row);
                        }
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Cannot load rental applications",
                        e
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    txtNoApplications.setVisibility(
                            View.VISIBLE
                    );
                    txtNoApplications.setText(
                            R.string.rental_applications_load_failed
                    );
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderCard(JSONObject application) {
        String id = application.optString("id", "");
        String listingId =
                application.optString("listing_id", "");
        String status =
                application.optString("status", "PENDING");

        CardView card = new CardView(this);

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params =

        content.addView(title);

        );
        state.setTypeface(null, 1);

        state.setTextColor(
                "APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)
                        ? Color.rgb(46, 125, 50)
                        : "DECLINED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)
                        ? Color.RED
                        : Color.rgb(200, 90, 50)
        );

        content.addView(state);

        if (isLandlordView
                && "PENDING".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {

            LinearLayout actions = new LinearLayout(this);
            actions.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);

            Button approve =
                    actionButton(R.string.btn_approve_lease);

                    actionButton(R.string.btn_decline_lease);

            actions.addView(

            actions.addView(
                    decline,

            );

            approve.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    updateStatus(
                            id, "APPROVED", approve, decline
                    )
            );

            decline.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    updateStatus(
                            id, "DECLINED", approve, decline
                    )
            );

            content.addView(actions);
        }

        if (!isLandlordView
                && "APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {

                startActivity(intent);

        applicationsContainer.addView(card);

        Button button = new Button(this);

        button.setText(stringId);
        button.setAllCaps(false);
        button.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);

    }

    private void updateStatus(
            String id,
            String status,
            Button approve,
            Button decline
    ) {
        String uid = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty()
                || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        approve.setEnabled(false);
        decline.setEnabled(false);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/rental_applications?id=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(id)
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(uid)
                                + "&status=eq.PENDING";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint, "PATCH", token
                );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer", "return=representation"
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", status);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                boolean ok = code >= 200
                        && code < 300
                        && new JSONArray(response).length() == 1;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (ok) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "APPROVED".equals(status)
                                        ? R.string.msg_application_approved
                                        : R.string.msg_application_declined,
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show();

                        loadApplications();

                    } else {
                        approve.setEnabled(true);
                        decline.setEnabled(true);

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                R.string.rental_application_update_failed,
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Cannot update rental application",
                        e
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    approve.setEnabled(true);
                    decline.setEnabled(true);

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            R.string.rental_application_update_failed,
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.Toast;
import android.view.View;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class ChangePasswordActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private EditText edtCurrentPassword;
    private EditText edtNewPassword;
    private EditText edtConfirmPassword;

    private View btnBack;
    private Button btnChangePassword;

    private final ExecutorService executor =
            Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private boolean changingPassword = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_change_password);

        edtCurrentPassword =
                findViewById(R.id.edtCurrentPassword);

        edtNewPassword =
                findViewById(R.id.edtNewPassword);

        edtConfirmPassword =
                findViewById(R.id.edtConfirmPassword);

        btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);

        btnChangePassword =
                findViewById(R.id.btnChangePassword);

        if (edtCurrentPassword == null
                || edtNewPassword == null
                || edtConfirmPassword == null
                || btnBack == null
                || btnChangePassword == null) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    R.string.password_screen_error,
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            finish();
            return;
        }

        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        btnChangePassword.setOnClickListener(
                v -> changePassword()
        );
    }

    private void changePassword() {
        if (changingPassword) {
            return;
        }

        String currentPassword =
                edtCurrentPassword.getText().toString();

        String newPassword =
                edtNewPassword.getText().toString();

        String confirmPassword =
                edtConfirmPassword.getText().toString();

        if (currentPassword.trim().isEmpty()
                || newPassword.trim().isEmpty()
                || confirmPassword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            showMessage(R.string.password_fill_all_fields);
            return;
        }

        if (newPassword.length() < 8) {
            showMessage(R.string.password_minimum_length);
            return;
        }

        if (!newPassword.equals(confirmPassword)) {
            showMessage(R.string.passwords_do_not_match);
            return;
        }

        if (currentPassword.equals(newPassword)) {
            showMessage(R.string.password_must_be_different);
            return;
        }

        changingPassword = true;
        btnChangePassword.setEnabled(false);

        UserProfileLoader.load(this, (name, email, phone) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }

            if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {
                changingPassword = false;
                btnChangePassword.setEnabled(true);

                showMessage(R.string.password_email_missing);
                return;
            }

            performPasswordChange(
                    email.trim(),
                    currentPassword,
                    newPassword
            );
        });
    }

    private void performPasswordChange(
            String email,
            String currentPassword,
            String newPassword
    ) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection verifyConnection = null;
            HttpURLConnection updateConnection = null;

            try {
                verifyConnection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                "/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password",
                                "POST",
                                null
                        );

                JSONObject verifyBody = new JSONObject();

                verifyBody.put("email", email);
                verifyBody.put("password", currentPassword);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(
                        verifyConnection,
                        verifyBody
                );

                int verifyCode =
                        verifyConnection.getResponseCode();

                String verifyResponse =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(
                                verifyConnection
                        );

                if (verifyCode < 200 || verifyCode >= 300) {
                    showMessage(
                            R.string.password_current_incorrect
                    );
                    return;
                }

                JSONObject session =
                        new JSONObject(verifyResponse);

                String accessToken =
                        session.optString("access_token", "");

                if (accessToken.isEmpty()) {
                    showMessage(
                            R.string.password_session_missing
                    );
                    return;
                }

                updateConnection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                "/auth/v1/user",
                                "PUT",
                                accessToken
                        );

                JSONObject updateBody = new JSONObject();

                updateBody.put("password", newPassword);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(
                        updateConnection,
                        updateBody
                );

                int updateCode =
                        updateConnection.getResponseCode();

                String updateResponse =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(
                                updateConnection
                        );

                if (updateCode >= 200 && updateCode < 300) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                            return;
                        }

                        edtCurrentPassword.setText("");
                        edtNewPassword.setText("");
                        edtConfirmPassword.setText("");

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                R.string.password_changed_successfully,
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();

                        finish();
                    });

                } else {
                    Log.e(
                            "ChangePassword",
                            "Supabase password update failed: "
                                    + updateCode
                                    + " "
                                    + updateResponse
                    );

                    showMessage(
                            R.string.password_update_failed
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        "ChangePassword",
                        "Password update error",
                        e
                );

                showMessage(
                        R.string.password_connection_error
                );

            } finally {
                if (verifyConnection != null) {
                    verifyConnection.disconnect();
                }

                if (updateConnection != null) {
                    updateConnection.disconnect();
                }

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    changingPassword = false;

                    if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                        btnChangePassword.setEnabled(true);
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void showMessage(int messageResource) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                Toast.makeText(
                        this,
                        messageResource,
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                ).show();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class ChatActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private LinearLayout messagesContainer;
    private ScrollView chatScrollView;
    private EditText editMessage;
    private Button btnSend;

    private String senderId;
    private String senderName;
    private String senderRole;
    private String receiverId;
    private String accessToken;

    private boolean isCommunity;
    private boolean fetchingMessages;
    private boolean sendingMessage;

    private String lastMessagesSnapshot = "";

    private final ExecutorService executor =
            Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private final Handler pollHandler =
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private final Runnable pollRunnable = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            fetchMessages();
            pollHandler.postDelayed(this, 3000);
        }
    };

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_chat);

        messagesContainer = findViewById(R.id.messagesContainer);
        chatScrollView = findViewById(R.id.chatScrollView);
        editMessage = findViewById(R.id.editMessage);
        btnSend = findViewById(R.id.btnSendMessage);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackChat);
        TextView txtTitle = findViewById(R.id.txtChatTitle);
        TextView txtSubtitle = findViewById(R.id.txtChatSubtitle);

        senderId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        senderName = getIntent().getStringExtra("SENDER_NAME");
        senderRole = getIntent().getStringExtra("SENDER_ROLE");
        receiverId = getIntent().getStringExtra("RECEIVER_ID");

        String receiverName =
                getIntent().getStringExtra("RECEIVER_NAME");

        isCommunity = getIntent().getBooleanExtra(
                "IS_COMMUNITY",
                false
        );

        if (senderName == null || senderName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            senderName = "iKhaya User";
        }

        if (senderRole == null || senderRole.trim().isEmpty()) {
            senderRole = "Member";
        }

        if (isCommunity) {
            receiverId = "COMMUNITY";
        }

        if (txtTitle != null) {
            txtTitle.setText(
                    receiverName != null
                            ? receiverName
                            : "Chat"
            );
        }

        if (txtSubtitle != null) {
            txtSubtitle.setText(
                    isCommunity
                            ? "Public Community Room (All Users)"
                            : "Direct Message"
            );
        }

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        if (btnSend != null) {
            btnSend.setOnClickListener(v -> sendMessage());
        }

        UserProfileLoader.load(this, (name, email, phone) -> {
            if (!name.isEmpty()) {
                senderName = name;
            }
        });

        if (senderId == null || senderId.trim().isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null || accessToken.trim().isEmpty()
                || receiverId == null || receiverId.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please sign in to use chat.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            if (btnSend != null) {
                btnSend.setEnabled(false);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();

        if (senderId != null && !senderId.isEmpty()
                && receiverId != null && !receiverId.isEmpty()
                && accessToken != null && !accessToken.isEmpty()) {

            pollHandler.removeCallbacks(pollRunnable);
            pollHandler.post(pollRunnable);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        pollHandler.removeCallbacks(pollRunnable);
        super.onPause();
    }

    private void fetchMessages() {
        if (fetchingMessages || executor.isShutdown()) {
            return;
        }

        fetchingMessages = true;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint;

                if (isCommunity) {
                    endpoint =
                            "/rest/v1/messages?receiver_id=eq.COMMUNITY"
                                    + "&order=created_at.asc&limit=150";
                } else {
                    String encodedSender =
                            SupabaseHelper.encode(senderId);

                    String encodedReceiver =
                            SupabaseHelper.encode(receiverId);

                    endpoint =
                            "/rest/v1/messages?or=(and(sender_id.eq."
                                    + encodedSender
                                    + ",receiver_id.eq."
                                    + encodedReceiver
                                    + "),and(sender_id.eq."
                                    + encodedReceiver
                                    + ",receiver_id.eq."
                                    + encodedSender
                                    + "))&order=created_at.asc&limit=150";
                }

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray messages = new JSONArray(response);
                    String snapshot = messages.toString();

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            if (!snapshot.equals(lastMessagesSnapshot)) {
                                lastMessagesSnapshot = snapshot;
                                renderMessages(messages);
                            }
                        }
                    });

                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        pollHandler.removeCallbacks(pollRunnable);

                        if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    "Failed to load messages (HTTP "
                                            + code + "): " + response,
                                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                            ).show();
                        }
                    });
                }

            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }

                fetchingMessages = false;
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderMessages(JSONArray messages) {
        if (messagesContainer == null) {
            return;
        }

        messagesContainer.removeAllViews();

        if (messages.length() == 0) {
            TextView txtEmptyChat = new TextView(this);
            txtEmptyChat.setText("No messages yet. Say hello!");
            txtEmptyChat.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
            txtEmptyChat.setTextSize(14f);
            txtEmptyChat.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            txtEmptyChat.setPadding(0, dpToPx(32), 0, dpToPx(32));
            messagesContainer.addView(txtEmptyChat);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < messages.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject message = messages.optJSONObject(i);

            if (message == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String messageSenderId =
                    message.optString("sender_id", "");

            String messageSenderName =
                    message.optString("sender_name", "User");

            String messageSenderRole =
                    message.optString("sender_role", "Member");

            String messageText =
                    message.optString("message_text", "");

            boolean isMe = messageSenderId.equals(senderId);

            addMessageBubble(
                    messageSenderName,
                    messageSenderRole,
                    messageText,
                    isMe
            );
        }

        if (chatScrollView != null) {
            chatScrollView.post(() ->
                    chatScrollView.fullScroll(View.FOCUS_DOWN)
            );
        }
    }

    private void addMessageBubble(
            String authorName,
            String authorRole,
            String messageText,
            boolean isMe
    ) {
        LinearLayout wrapper = new LinearLayout(this);

        wrapper.setLayoutParams(
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                )
        );

        wrapper.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        wrapper.setGravity(isMe ? Gravity.END : Gravity.START);

        CardView bubble = new CardView(this);

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams bubbleParams =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );

        int horizontalMargin = dpToPx(40);

        bubbleParams.setMargins(
                isMe ? horizontalMargin : 0,
                dpToPx(4),
                isMe ? 0 : horizontalMargin,
                dpToPx(8)
        );

        bubble.setLayoutParams(bubbleParams);
        bubble.setRadius(dpToPx(15));
        bubble.setCardElevation(dpToPx(2));

        bubble.setCardBackgroundColor(
                Color.parseColor(
                        isMe ? "#FFE8CC" : "#FFFFFF"
                )
        );

        LinearLayout content = new LinearLayout(this);
        content.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);

        content.setPadding(
                dpToPx(16),
                dpToPx(10),
                dpToPx(16),
                dpToPx(10)
        );

        if (!isMe && isCommunity) {
            TextView txtAuthor = new TextView(this);

            txtAuthor.setText(
                    authorName + " â€¢ "
                            + authorRole.toUpperCase()
            );

            txtAuthor.setTextSize(12f);
            txtAuthor.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);

            txtAuthor.setTextColor(
                    Color.parseColor("#D9480F")
            );

            content.addView(txtAuthor);
        }

        TextView txtMessage = new TextView(this);

        txtMessage.setText(messageText);
        txtMessage.setTextSize(15f);

        txtMessage.setTextColor(
                Color.parseColor("#212529")
        );

        content.addView(txtMessage);
        bubble.addView(content);
        wrapper.addView(bubble);
        messagesContainer.addView(wrapper);
    }

    private void sendMessage() {
        if (sendingMessage || editMessage == null) {
            return;
        }

        String messageText =
                editMessage.getText().toString().trim();

        if (messageText.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        if (senderId == null || senderId.isEmpty()
                || receiverId == null || receiverId.isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please sign in to send messages.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        sendingMessage = true;

        if (btnSend != null) {
            btnSend.setEnabled(false);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            boolean success = false;
            String error = "";

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/messages",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "return=minimal"
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();

                body.put("sender_id", senderId);
                body.put("sender_name", senderName);
                body.put("sender_role", senderRole);
                body.put("receiver_id", receiverId);
                body.put("message_text", messageText);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                success = code >= 200 && code < 300;

                if (!success) {
                    error = "Send failed (HTTP "
                            + code + "): " + response;
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = "Error sending message: "
                        + e.getMessage();

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }

            boolean sent = success;
            String failureMessage = error;

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                sendingMessage = false;

                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                    return;
                }

                if (btnSend != null) {
                    btnSend.setEnabled(true);
                }

                if (sent) {
                    if (messageText.equals(
                            editMessage.getText().toString().trim()
                    )) {
                        editMessage.setText("");
                    }

                    fetchMessages();
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            failureMessage,
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        return Math.round(
                dp * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        pollHandler.removeCallbacks(pollRunnable);
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\CreatePasswordActivity.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class CreatePasswordActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private final Pattern uppercasePattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Z]");
    private final Pattern lowercasePattern = Pattern.compile("[a-z]");
    private final Pattern numberPattern = Pattern.compile("[0-9]");
    private final Pattern specialCharPattern = Pattern.compile("[^a-zA-Z0-9]");

    private EditText editPassword;
    private ProgressBar passwordStrengthProgressbar;
    private Button registerBtn;

    private ImageView uppercaseIcon;
    private ImageView lowercaseIcon;
    private ImageView numberIcon;
    private ImageView specialIcon;

    private TextView uppercaseText;
    private TextView lowercaseText;
    private TextView numberText;
    private TextView specialText;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_passwordpage);

        ImageButton backButton = findViewById(R.id.back_button);
        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        editPassword = findViewById(R.id.editPassword);
        passwordStrengthProgressbar =
                findViewById(R.id.passwordStrengthProgressbar);
        registerBtn = findViewById(R.id.registerBtn);

        uppercaseIcon = findViewById(R.id.uppercaseCheckerIcon);
        lowercaseIcon = findViewById(R.id.lowercaseCheckerIcon);
        numberIcon = findViewById(R.id.numberCheckerIcon);
        specialIcon = findViewById(R.id.specialCharacterIcon);

        uppercaseText = findViewById(R.id.uppercaseChecker);
        lowercaseText = findViewById(R.id.lowercaseChecker);
        numberText = findViewById(R.id.numberChecker);
        specialText = findViewById(R.id.specialCharacter);

        if (editPassword == null
                || passwordStrengthProgressbar == null
                || registerBtn == null
                || uppercaseIcon == null
                || lowercaseIcon == null
                || numberIcon == null
                || specialIcon == null
                || uppercaseText == null
                || lowercaseText == null
                || numberText == null
                || specialText == null) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Password screen layout is missing a required view.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            finish();
            return;
        }

        registerBtn.setEnabled(false);
        passwordStrengthProgressbar.setMax(4);

        editPassword.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(
                    CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {
            }

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(
                    CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {
                String password = s.toString();

                boolean hasUppercase =
                        uppercasePattern.matcher(password).find();
                boolean hasLowercase =
                        lowercasePattern.matcher(password).find();
                boolean hasNumber =
                        numberPattern.matcher(password).find();
                boolean hasSpecial =
                        specialCharPattern.matcher(password).find();

                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasUppercase, uppercaseIcon, uppercaseText);
                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasLowercase, lowercaseIcon, lowercaseText);
                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasNumber, numberIcon, numberText);
                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasSpecial, specialIcon, specialText);

                int progress = 0;
                if (hasUppercase) progress++;
                if (hasLowercase) progress++;
                if (hasNumber) progress++;
                if (hasSpecial) progress++;

                passwordStrengthProgressbar.setProgress(progress);

                if (progress <= 1) {
                    passwordStrengthProgressbar.getProgressDrawable()
                            .setTint(Color.parseColor("#F44336"));
                } else if (progress <= 3) {
                    passwordStrengthProgressbar.getProgressDrawable()
                            .setTint(Color.parseColor("#FFEB3B"));
                } else {
                    passwordStrengthProgressbar.getProgressDrawable()
                            .setTint(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"));
                }

                registerBtn.setEnabled(
                        progress == 4 && password.length() >= 8);
            }
        });

        registerBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> continueRegistration());
    }

    private void continueRegistration() {
        String username = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_NAME");
        String surname = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_SURNAME");
        String phone = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_PHONE");
        String email = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_EMAIL");
        String role = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_ROLE");
        String password = editPassword.getText().toString();

        if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Your email is missing. Please restart registration.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        if (password.length() < 8
                || !uppercasePattern.matcher(password).find()
                || !lowercasePattern.matcher(password).find()
                || !numberPattern.matcher(password).find()
                || !specialCharPattern.matcher(password).find()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please meet all password requirements.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        Intent nextIntent =
                new Intent(CreatePasswordActivity.this, PersonalActivity.class);

        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_NAME", username);
        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_SURNAME", surname);
        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_PHONE", phone);
        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_EMAIL", email);
        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_ROLE", role);
        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_PASSWORD", password);

        startActivity(nextIntent);
    }

    private void updateRequirementUI(
            boolean isMet,
            ImageView icon,
            TextView text) {

        int color = isMet
                ? Color.parseColor("#4CAF50")
                : Color.parseColor("#808080");

        icon.setColorFilter(color);
        text.setTextColor(color);
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class EditListingActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private EditText nameInput;
    private EditText locationInput;
    private EditText priceInput;
    private EditText roomsInput;
    private EditText typeInput;
    private EditText descriptionInput;
    private ImageView imagePreview;
    private Button uploadImageButton;
    private Button saveButton;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private String listingId = "";
    private String userId = "";
    private String accessToken = "";
    private Uri selectedImageUri = null;
    private String currentImageUrl = "";

    // Image Picker Launcher
    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String> imagePicker =
            registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.GetContent(), uri -> {
                if (uri != null) {
                    selectedImageUri = uri;
                    imagePreview.setImageURI(uri);
                    uploadImageButton.setText(R.string.photos_selected_count);
                }
            });

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_edit_listing);

        nameInput = findViewById(R.id.edtEditPropertyName);
        locationInput = findViewById(R.id.edtEditLocation);
        priceInput = findViewById(R.id.edtEditPrice);
        roomsInput = findViewById(R.id.edtEditRooms);
        typeInput = findViewById(R.id.edtEditPropertyType);
        descriptionInput = findViewById(R.id.edtEditDescription);
        imagePreview = findViewById(R.id.imgEditProperty);
        uploadImageButton = findViewById(R.id.btnUploadImageEdit);
        saveButton = findViewById(R.id.btnSaveListingChanges);

        View backButton = findViewById(R.id.btnBackEditListing);
        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        listingId = getIntent().getStringExtra("LISTING_ID");
        if (listingId == null || listingId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            listingId = getIntent().getStringExtra("listingId");
        }

        userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (listingId == null || listingId.trim().isEmpty() || userId == null || accessToken == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Missing credentials or listing ID.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }

        uploadImageButton.setOnClickListener(v -> imagePicker.launch("image/*"));
        saveButton.setOnClickListener(v -> saveChanges());

        loadListing();
    }

    private void loadListing() {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?select=*&id=eq." + encode(listingId) + "&landlord_uid=eq." + encode(userId) + "&limit=1";
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray data = new JSONArray(response);
                    if (data.length() > 0) {
                        JSONObject listing = data.getJSONObject(0);
                        currentImageUrl = listing.optString("image_url", "");

                        runOnUiThread(() -> {
                            nameInput.setText(listing.optString("property_name", ""));
                            locationInput.setText(listing.optString("location", ""));
                            priceInput.setText(listing.optString("price", ""));
                            roomsInput.setText(listing.optString("rooms", ""));
                            typeInput.setText(listing.optString("property_type", ""));
                            descriptionInput.setText(listing.optString("description", ""));
                        });

                        if (!currentImageUrl.isEmpty()) {
                            loadExistingImage(currentImageUrl);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage("Could not load listing details.");
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadExistingImage(String urlString) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                URL url = new URL(urlString);
                HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                conn.connect();
                InputStream in = conn.getInputStream();
                Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(in);
                if (bitmap != null) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> imagePreview.setImageBitmap(bitmap));
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e("EditListing", "Failed to load existing image", e);
            }
        });
    }

    private void saveChanges() {
        String name = nameInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String location = locationInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String price = priceInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String rooms = roomsInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String type = typeInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String description = descriptionInput.getText().toString().trim();

        if (name.isEmpty() || location.isEmpty() || price.isEmpty() || rooms.isEmpty() || type.isEmpty() || description.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.password_fill_all_fields, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        double parsedPrice;
        int parsedRooms;

        try {
            parsedPrice = Double.parseDouble(price);
            parsedRooms = Integer.parseInt(rooms);
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter valid numbers for price and rooms.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        saveButton.setEnabled(false);
        saveButton.setText("Saving changes...");

        executor.execute(() -> {
            String finalImageUrl = currentImageUrl;

            // 1. Upload new image if the user picked one
            if (selectedImageUri != null) {
                String imagePath = userId + "/" + listingId + "/property_edit_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".jpg";
                boolean uploaded = uploadImageToStorage(selectedImageUri, imagePath);

                if (uploaded) {
                    finalImageUrl = SupabaseHelper.getPublicStorageUrl("property-images", imagePath);
                } else {
                    showMessage("Image upload failed. Saving text changes only.");
                }
            }

            // 2. Patch the database row
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + encode(listingId) + "&landlord_uid=eq." + encode(userId);
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "PATCH", accessToken);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=representation");

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("property_name", name);
                body.put("location", location);
                body.put("price", parsedPrice);
                body.put("rooms", parsedRooms);
                body.put("property_type", type);
                body.put("description", description);

                if (finalImageUrl != null && !finalImageUrl.isEmpty()) {
                    body.put("image_url", finalImageUrl);
                }

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    saveButton.setEnabled(true);
                    saveButton.setText(R.string.save_changes);

                    if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                        Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, "Listing updated successfully.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        setResult(RESULT_OK);
                        finish();
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, "Update failed (HTTP " + code + ")", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    saveButton.setEnabled(true);
                    saveButton.setText(R.string.save_changes);
                    Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, "Network error updating listing.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private boolean uploadImageToStorage(Uri imageUri, String imagePath) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createStorageConnection("property-images", imagePath, "POST", accessToken);
            String mimeType = getContentResolver().getType(imageUri);
            connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", mimeType != null ? mimeType : "image/jpeg");
            connection.setRequestProperty("x-upsert", "true");
            connection.setDoOutput(true);

            try (InputStream inputStream = getContentResolver().openInputStream(imageUri);
                 OutputStream outputStream = connection.getOutputStream()) {
                if (inputStream == null) return false;
                byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                int bytesRead;
                while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    outputStream.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
                }
                outputStream.flush();
            }
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            return code >= 200 && code < 300;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e("EditListing", "Image upload failed", e);
            return false;
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
    }

    private String encode(String value) throws Exception {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

public class EnquiriesActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextView txtNoEnquiries;

    private String currentUserId;
    private String accessToken;

    private volatile boolean loadingEnquiries = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_enquiries);

        enquiriesContainer = findViewById(R.id.enquiriesContainer);
        txtNoEnquiries = findViewById(R.id.txtNoEnquiries);

    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {

    }

    private void loadEnquiries() {
        if (loadingEnquiries) {
            return;
        }

        currentUserId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (currentUserId == null
                || currentUserId.trim().isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null
                || accessToken.trim().isEmpty()) {

            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        loadingEnquiries = true;

        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/enquiries"
                                + "?select=*"
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(currentUserId)
                                + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode < 200 || responseCode >= 300) {
                    showMessage("Could not load enquiries.");
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray enquiries = new JSONArray(response);

                LandlordNotificationState.markSeen(
                        getApplicationContext(),
                        "enquiries",
                        currentUserId,
                        enquiries
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    enquiriesContainer.removeAllViews();

                    if (enquiries.length() == 0) {
                        txtNoEnquiries.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        return;
                    }

                    txtNoEnquiries.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                    for (int i = 0; i < enquiries.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject enquiry = enquiries.optJSONObject(i);

                        if (enquiry != null) {
                            addEnquiry(enquiry);
                        }
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage(
                        "Could not load enquiries. Please try again."
                );

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }

                loadingEnquiries = false;
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private void addEnquiry(JSONObject enquiry) {
        String id = enquiry.optString("id", "");

        String message = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "message",
                "enquiry_message",
                "content"
        );

        String status = enquiry.optString(
                "status",
                "Pending"
        );

        String senderName = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "sender_name",
                "tenant_name",
                "applicant_name",
                "full_name",
                "name"
        );

        String senderPhone = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "sender_phone",
                "tenant_phone",
                "phone",
                "phone_number"
        );

        String senderEmail = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "sender_email",
                "tenant_email",
                "email"
        );

        String senderId = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "tenant_uid",
                "sender_uid",
                "user_uid",
                "applicant_uid"
        );

        if (senderName.isEmpty()) {
            senderName = "Tenant";
        }

        if (message.isEmpty()) {
            message = "No message provided.";
        }

        LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
        card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);

        card.setPadding(
                dp(16),
                dp(16),
                dp(16),
                dp(16)
        );

        card.setBackground(
                roundedBackground(
                        Color.WHITE,
                        "#E5E5E5",
                        14
                )
        );

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams cardParams =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );

        cardParams.bottomMargin = dp(14);
        card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);
        card.setElevation(dp(2));

        TextView sender = new TextView(this);
        sender.setText(senderName);
        sender.setTextSize(18);
        sender.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        sender.setTextColor(Color.rgb(34, 34, 34));

        TextView statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setText("Status: " + status);
        statusView.setTextSize(13);
        statusView.setTextColor(Color.rgb(211, 47, 47));

        statusView.setPadding(

                dp(5),

                    .append(senderEmail)
                    .append("\n");

        if (!senderId.isEmpty()) {
            detailsText.append("User ID: ")
                    .append(senderId)
                    .append("\n");
        }

        detailsText.append("\nMessage\n")
                .append(message);

        details.setText(detailsText.toString());
        details.setTextSize(14);
        details.setTextColor(Color.rgb(75, 75, 75));
        details.setLineSpacing(dp(3), 1f);

        card.addView(sender);
        card.addView(statusView);
        card.addView(details);

            LinearLayout actions = new LinearLayout(this);
            actions.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            actions.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);

            actions.setPadding(
                    0,
                    dp(14),
                    0,
                    0
            );

            Button approveButton = new Button(this);
            approveButton.setText("Approve contact");
            approveButton.setAllCaps(false);
            approveButton.setTextSize(12);

            approveButton.setBackgroundResource(
                    R.drawable.selector_regular_button
            );

            Button denyButton = new Button(this);
            denyButton.setText("Deny");

                    new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(

                            1f
                    );

            denyParams.setMarginStart(dp(6));
            denyButton.setLayoutParams(denyParams);

            approveButton.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    updateEnquiryStatus(
                            id,
                            "Approved",

                    )
            );

            denyButton.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    updateEnquiryStatus(
                            id,
                            "Declined",
                            approveButton,
                            denyButton
                    )
            );

            actions.addView(approveButton);
            actions.addView(denyButton);
            card.addView(actions);
        }

        enquiriesContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private void updateEnquiryStatus(
            String id,
            String newStatus,
            Button approveButton,
            Button denyButton
    ) {
        if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "This enquiry has no ID; it cannot be updated.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null
                || userId.isEmpty()
                || token == null
                || token.isEmpty()) {

            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        approveButton.setEnabled(false);
        denyButton.setEnabled(false);

        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/enquiries"
                                + "?id=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(id)
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "PATCH",
                        token
                );

                connection.setDoOutput(true);

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Content-Type",
                        "application/json"
                );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "return=minimal"
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", newStatus);

                try (OutputStream output =
                             connection.getOutputStream()) {

                    output.write(
                            body.toString().getBytes(
                                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                            )
                    );
                }

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                boolean success = code >= 200 && code < 300;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (success) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                newStatus.equals("Approved")
                                        ? "Contact request approved."
                                        : "Contact request declined.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show();

                        loadEnquiries();

                    } else {
                        approveButton.setEnabled(true);
                        denyButton.setEnabled(true);

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "Could not update this enquiry. Check your Supabase permissions and status values.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    approveButton.setEnabled(true);
                    denyButton.setEnabled(true);

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            "Could not update enquiry.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private String firstValue(
            JSONObject object,
            String... keys
    ) {
        for (String key : keys) {
            String value = object.optString(key, "");

            if (!value.trim().isEmpty()
                    && !"null".equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {

                return value.trim();
            }
        }

        return "";
    }

    private GradientDrawable roundedBackground(
            int fillColor,
            String strokeColor,
            int radiusDp
    ) {
        GradientDrawable drawable = new GradientDrawable();

        drawable.setColor(fillColor);
        drawable.setCornerRadius(dp(radiusDp));

        drawable.setStroke(
                dp(1),
                Color.parseColor(strokeColor)
        );

        return drawable;
    }

    private int dp(int value) {
        return (int) (
                value
                        * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density
                        + 0.5f
        );
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                Toast.makeText(
                        this,
                        message,
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show();
            }
        });
    }
}
