package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import com.google.android.material.bottomsheet.BottomSheetDialogFragment;
import com.google.android.material.chip.Chip;
import com.google.android.material.chip.ChipGroup;

public class FilterBottomSheetDialog extends BottomSheetDialogFragment {

    public interface FilterListener {
        void onFiltersApplied(String maxPrice, String roomType, boolean wifi, boolean water, boolean backupPower);
    }

    private FilterListener listener;

    public void setFilterListener(FilterListener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    @Override
    public View onCreateView(LayoutInflater inflater, ViewGroup container, Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        View view = inflater.inflate(R.layout.layout_filter_bottom_sheet, container, false);

        ChipGroup chipGroupPrice = view.findViewById(R.id.chipGroupPrice);
        ChipGroup chipGroupRoom = view.findViewById(R.id.chipGroupRoomType);
        Chip chipWifi = view.findViewById(R.id.chipUtilWifi);
        Chip chipWater = view.findViewById(R.id.chipUtilWater);
        Chip chipPower = view.findViewById(R.id.chipUtilBackupPower);

        view.findViewById(R.id.btnCloseDialog).setOnClickListener(v -> dismiss());

        view.findViewById(R.id.btnResetFilters).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            chipGroupPrice.clearCheck();
            chipGroupRoom.clearCheck();
            chipWifi.setChecked(false);
            chipWater.setChecked(false);
            chipPower.setChecked(false);
        });

        view.findViewById(R.id.btnApplyFilters).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) {
                // Determine max budget
                String maxPrice = "";
                int priceChipId = chipGroupPrice.getCheckedChipId();
                if (priceChipId == R.id.chipPrice1) maxPrice = "1500";
                else if (priceChipId == R.id.chipPrice2) maxPrice = "2500";
                else if (priceChipId == R.id.chipPrice3) maxPrice = "4000";

                // Determine selected room type
                String roomType = "";
                int roomChipId = chipGroupRoom.getCheckedChipId();
                if (roomChipId == R.id.chipTypeSingle) roomType = "Single";
                else if (roomChipId == R.id.chipTypeShared) roomType = "Shared";
                else if (roomChipId == R.id.chipTypeBachelor) roomType = "Bachelor";
                else if (roomChipId == R.id.chipTypeHouse) roomType = "House";

                listener.onFiltersApplied(
                        maxPrice,
                        roomType,
                        chipWifi.isChecked(),
                        chipWater.isChecked(),
                        chipPower.isChecked()
                );
            }
            dismiss();
        });

        return view;
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\GeminiTranslator.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

import okhttp3.Call;
import okhttp3.Callback;
import okhttp3.MediaType;
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient;
import okhttp3.Request;
import okhttp3.RequestBody;
import okhttp3.Response;

public class GeminiTranslator {

    private static final String API_KEY = BuildConfig.GEMINI_API_KEY;

    // Direct, pinned model endpoint to avoid deprecated alias 404s
    // Use the current active 3.5 production model
    private static final String API_URL = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3.5-flash:generateContent";

    // Reusable client with socket timeouts to prevent timeout drops
    private static final OkHttpClient client = new OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .connectTimeout(25, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .readTimeout(35, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .writeTimeout(25, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
            .build();

    public interface TranslationCallback {
        void onSuccess(String translatedText);
        void onError(String errorMessage);
    }

    public static void translate(String text, String targetLang, TranslationCallback callback) {
        translateWithRetry(text, targetLang, callback, 2);
    }

    private static void translateWithRetry(String text, String targetLang, TranslationCallback callback, int retriesLeft) {
        String languageName;
        switch (targetLang) {
            case "zu":
                languageName = "isiZulu";
                break;
            case "xh":
                languageName = "isiXhosa";
                break;
            case "st":
                languageName = "Southern Sotho (Sesotho)";
                break;
            default:
                languageName = "English";
                break;
        }

        String prompt = "Translate this South African rental accommodation description into natural, everyday " + languageName + ". "
                + "Ensure terms like rent, water, electricity, and transport sound natural and grammatically correct. "
                + "Do not include quotes, markdown formatting, or preamble. Return ONLY the translated text:\n\n"
                + text;

        Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

        try {
            JSONObject textPart = new JSONObject();
            textPart.put("text", prompt);

            JSONArray partsArray = new JSONArray();
            partsArray.put(textPart);

            JSONObject contentObj = new JSONObject();
            contentObj.put("parts", partsArray);

            JSONArray contentsArray = new JSONArray();
            contentsArray.put(contentObj);

            JSONObject payload = new JSONObject();
            payload.put("contents", contentsArray);

            RequestBody body = RequestBody.create(
                    payload.toString(),
                    MediaType.get("application/json; charset=utf-8")
            );

            Request request = new Request.Builder()
                    .url(API_URL)
                    .addHeader("X-goog-api-key", API_KEY)
                    .addHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
                    .post(body)
                    .build();

            client.newCall(request).enqueue(new Callback() {
                @Override
                public void onFailure(Call call, IOException e) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Network error: " + e.getMessage()));
                }

                @Override
                public void onResponse(Call call, Response response) throws IOException {
                    String responseBody = response.body() != null ? response.body().string() : "";

                    if (response.isSuccessful()) {
                        try {
                            JSONObject json = new JSONObject(responseBody);
                            JSONArray candidates = json.getJSONArray("candidates");
                            JSONObject firstCandidate = candidates.getJSONObject(0);
                            JSONObject content = firstCandidate.getJSONObject("content");
                            JSONArray parts = content.getJSONArray("parts");
                            String translatedResult = parts.getJSONObject(0).getString("text").trim();

                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onSuccess(translatedResult));
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Parsing error: " + e.getMessage()));
                        }
                    } else if (response.code() == 503 && retriesLeft > 0) {
                        mainHandler.postDelayed(() -> translateWithRetry(text, targetLang, callback, retriesLeft - 1), 2000);
                    } else {
                        try {
                            JSONObject errJson = new JSONObject(responseBody);
                            String message = errJson.getJSONObject("error").getString("message");
                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("(" + response.code() + ") " + message));
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("(" + response.code() + ") " + responseBody));
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

        } catch (Exception e) {
            callback.onError("Request error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

    private void refreshNotifications() {
        if (notificationLoading || notificationExecutor.isShutdown()) return;

        String uid = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            if (notificationDot != null) notificationDot.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            if (messageDot != null) messageDot.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }

        notificationLoading = true;

        notificationExecutor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String encodedUid = SupabaseHelper.encode(uid);

                JSONArray messages = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/messages?select=id&receiver_id=eq." + encodedUid + "&order=created_at.desc&limit=1000",
                        token
                );

                JSONArray applications = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/rental_applications?select=id,status&tenant_uid=eq." + encodedUid + "&status=in.(APPROVED,DECLINED,approved,declined)&limit=1000",
                        token
                );

                JSONArray chatRequests = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/chat_requests?select=id,status&receiver_id=eq." + encodedUid + "&status=eq.pending&limit=1000",
                        token
                );

                boolean unreadMessages = messages != null && TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "messages", messages);
                boolean unreadApplications = applications != null && TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "applications", applications);
                boolean unreadChatRequests = chatRequests != null && TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "chat_requests", chatRequests);
                boolean unreadAlerts = unreadApplications || unreadChatRequests;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    notificationUserId = uid;
                    if (messages != null) latestMessages = messages;
                    if (applications != null) latestApplications = applications;
                    if (chatRequests != null) latestChatRequests = chatRequests;

                    if (messageDot != null) {
                        messageDot.setVisibility(unreadMessages ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                    }
                    if (notificationDot != null) {
                        notificationDot.setVisibility(unreadAlerts ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                notificationLoading = false;
            }
        });
    }

    private void markAlertsChecked() {
        String uid = notificationUserId;
        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;

        if (latestApplications != null) {
            TenantNotificationState.markSeen(this, uid, "applications", latestApplications);
        }
        if (latestChatRequests != null) {
            TenantNotificationState.markSeen(this, uid, "chat_requests", latestChatRequests);
        }
        if (notificationDot != null) {
            notificationDot.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private void markMessagesChecked() {
        String uid = notificationUserId;
        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;

        if (latestMessages != null) {
            TenantNotificationState.markSeen(this, uid, "messages", latestMessages);
        }
        if (messageDot != null) {
            messageDot.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private JSONArray fetchRows(String endpoint, String token) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                return new JSONArray(response);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void setupPersonalizedGreeting() {
        TextView tvHomeGreeting = findViewById(R.id.tvHomeGreeting);
        if (tvHomeGreeting == null) return;

        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);
        String fullName = prefs.getString("USER_NAME", "");
        if (fullName.isEmpty()) {
            fullName = prefs.getString("user_name", "");
        }

        if (!fullName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            String firstName = fullName.trim().split("\\s+")[0];
            tvHomeGreeting.setText(getString(R.string.home_greeting_personalized, firstName));
        } else {
            tvHomeGreeting.setText(R.string.home_greeting_default);
        }
    }

    private void loadHomeFeedFromSupabase() {
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        if (accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) return;

        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/listings?select=*&order=created_at.desc&limit=20",
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray rawListings = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<JSONObject> popularList = new ArrayList<>();
                    List<JSONObject> exploreList = new ArrayList<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < rawListings.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject item = rawListings.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (item == null) continue;

                        if (i % 2 == 0) {
                            popularList.add(item);
                        } else {
                            exploreList.add(item);
                        }
                    }

                    if (exploreList.isEmpty()) {
                        exploreList.addAll(popularList);
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                        if (rvPopularPlaces != null) {
                            rvPopularPlaces.setAdapter(new ListingCarouselAdapter(popularList));
                        }
                        if (rvExploreNewArea != null) {
                            rvExploreNewArea.setAdapter(new ListingCarouselAdapter(exploreList));
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private void setupBottomNavigation() {
        View navHome = findViewById(R.id.navHome);
        if (navHome != null) {
            navHome.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                View homeScroll = findViewById(R.id.homeScrollView);

                    startActivity(new Intent(HomeActivity.this, ViewingsActivity.class))
            );

                markMessagesChecked();
                startActivity(new Intent(HomeActivity.this, UserSelectionActivity.class));
            });
        }
    }

        }
        startActivity(intent);
    }

                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            );
            priceParams.topMargin = Math.round(6 * density);
            price.setLayoutParams(priceParams);
            root.addView(price);

            card.addView(root);
            return new ListingViewHolder(card, image, title, location, price);

        @Override
        public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ListingViewHolder holder, int position) {
            JSONObject item = items.get(position);
            String id = item.optString("id", "");
            String name = item.optString("property_name", getString(R.string.accommodation));
            String location = item.optString("location", "South Africa");
            String price = item.optString("price", "0");
            String imageUrl = item.optString("image_url", "");

            holder.tvTitle.setText(name);
            holder.tvLocation.setText(getString(R.string.listing_location_pin, location));
            holder.tvPrice.setText(getString(R.string.listing_price_month, price));

            holder.ivImage.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery);
            if (!imageUrl.isEmpty()) {
                loadImageAsync(imageUrl, holder.ivImage);
            }

            holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent intent = new Intent(HomeActivity.this, PropertyDetailsActivity.class);
                intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", id);
                startActivity(intent);
            });
        }

        @Override
        public int getItemCount() {
            return items.size();
        }

        private void loadImageAsync(String urlStr, ImageView imageView) {
            imageExecutor.execute(() -> {
                HttpURLConnection conn = null;
                try {
                    conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(urlStr).openConnection();
                    conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                    conn.setReadTimeout(15000);
                    int res = conn.getResponseCode();
                    if (res >= 200 && res < 300) {
                        try (InputStream in = conn.getInputStream()) {
                            Bitmap bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(in);
                            if (bmp != null) {
                                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                    imageView.setImageBitmap(bmp);
                                    imageView.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                } finally {
                    if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
                }
            });
        }

        class ListingViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
            final ImageView ivImage;
            final TextView tvTitle;
            final TextView tvLocation;
            final TextView tvPrice;

            ListingViewHolder(View itemView, ImageView ivImage, TextView tvTitle, TextView tvLocation, TextView tvPrice) {
                super(itemView);
                this.ivImage = ivImage;
                this.tvTitle = tvTitle;
                this.tvLocation = tvLocation;
                this.tvPrice = tvPrice;
            }
        }
    }

=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\IdSecurityHelper.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.util.Base64;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.text.ParseException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

import javax.crypto.Cipher;
import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

public class IdSecurityHelper {

    private static final String AES_ALGORITHM = "AES";
    private static final String CIPHER_TRANSFORMATION = "AES/GCM/NoPadding";
    private static final int GCM_IV_LENGTH = 12;
    private static final int GCM_TAG_LENGTH = 128;

    // Hardcoded static key (32 bytes for AES-256) so the backend/admin can decrypt it.
    private static final String SHARED_SECRET_STRING = "iKaya_Secure_Key_2026_Shared_123";
    private static SecretKeySpec secretKey;

    static {
        try {
            // Convert the hardcoded string into a SecretKeySpec
            byte[] keyBytes = SHARED_SECRET_STRING.getBytes("UTF-8");
            secretKey = new SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, AES_ALGORITHM);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    /**
     * 1. Luhn Checksum Algorithm for 13-digit string.
     */
    public static boolean isValidLuhn(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.length() != 13 || !id.matches("\\d+")) {
            return false;
        }

        int sum = 0;
        boolean alternate = false;

        for (int i = id.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int n = Integer.parseInt(id.substring(i, i + 1));
            if (alternate) {
                n *= 2;
                if (n > 9) {
                    n = (n % 10) + 1;
                }
            }
            sum += n;
            alternate = !alternate;
        }
        return (sum % 10 == 0);
    }

    /**
     * 2. Extracts first 6 digits, strict validates date, and calculates age.
     */
    public static int getAgeAndValidateDate(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.length() < 6) {
            return -1;
        }

        String dobString = id.substring(0, 6);
        SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyMMdd", Locale.getDefault());
        sdf.setLenient(false); // Strict date checking (e.g. catches Feb 29 on non-leap years)

        try {
            Date dob = sdf.parse(dobString);
            if (dob == null) return -1;

            Calendar dobCal = Calendar.getInstance();
            dobCal.setTime(dob);

            // Handle YY century wrapping issue (South African IDs only have 2 digit years)
            // If the ID year is less than or equal to the current 2-digit year, treat it as 2000+.
            // If it is greater, treat it as 1900+.
            Calendar today = Calendar.getInstance();
            int currentYear = today.get(Calendar.YEAR);
            int currentTwoDigitYear = currentYear % 100;
            
            int idYear = Integer.parseInt(dobString.substring(0, 2));
            
            int actualBirthYear;
            if (idYear <= currentTwoDigitYear) {
                actualBirthYear = 2000 + idYear;
            } else {
                actualBirthYear = 1900 + idYear;
            }
            
            dobCal.set(Calendar.YEAR, actualBirthYear);

            int age = today.get(Calendar.YEAR) - dobCal.get(Calendar.YEAR);

            if (today.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) < dobCal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR)) {
                age--;
            }

            return age;

        } catch (ParseException e) {
            return -1; // Invalid date
        }
    }

    /**
     * 3. Encrypts string using AES/GCM/NoPadding.
     */
    public static String encryptId(String plainTextId) {
        try {
            byte[] iv = new byte[GCM_IV_LENGTH];
            new SecureRandom().nextBytes(iv);

            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_TRANSFORMATION);
            GCMParameterSpec parameterSpec = new GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv);
            cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey, parameterSpec);

            byte[] cipherText = cipher.doFinal(plainTextId.getBytes("UTF-8"));

            // Combine IV and cipherText
            byte[] combined = new byte[iv.length + cipherText.length];
            System.arraycopy(iv, 0, combined, 0, iv.length);
            System.arraycopy(cipherText, 0, combined, iv.length, cipherText.length);

            return Base64.encodeToString(combined, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * 4. Decrypts Base64 encrypted string using AES/GCM/NoPadding.
     */
    public static String decryptId(String base64EncryptedId) {
        try {
            byte[] combined = Base64.decode(base64EncryptedId, Base64.DEFAULT);

            byte[] iv = new byte[GCM_IV_LENGTH];
            System.arraycopy(combined, 0, iv, 0, iv.length);

            byte[] cipherText = new byte[combined.length - iv.length];
            System.arraycopy(combined, iv.length, cipherText, 0, cipherText.length);

            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_TRANSFORMATION);
            GCMParameterSpec parameterSpec = new GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv);
            cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, parameterSpec);

            byte[] plainText = cipher.doFinal(cipherText);

            return new String(plainText, "UTF-8");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return null;
        }
    }
}

import android.content.Intent;

    private void refreshDashboardData() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                JSONArray listings = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/listings?select=status,availability&landlord_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId),
                        token
                );

                int total = listings.length();
                int available = 0;
                int pending = 0;

                for (int i = 0; i < listings.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject listing = listings.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (listing == null) continue;

                    String availability = listing.optString("availability", "");
                    String status = listing.optString("status", "");

                    if ("available".equalsIgnoreCase(availability) || "available".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                        available++;
                    }
                    if ("pending".equalsIgnoreCase(availability) || "pending".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                        pending++;
                    }
                }

                final int fTotal = total;
                final int fAvailable = available;
                final int fPending = pending;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    if (txtTotalListings != null) txtTotalListings.setText(String.valueOf(fTotal));
                    if (txtAvailableListings != null) txtAvailableListings.setText(String.valueOf(fAvailable));
                    if (txtPendingListings != null) txtPendingListings.setText(String.valueOf(fPending));
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not load properties metrics", e);
            }
        });
    }

    private void refreshEnquiryBadge() {
        if (badgeLoading || executor.isShutdown()) return;

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            setDot(txtNotificationBadge, false);
            setDot(landlordMessageDot, false);
            setDot(enquiriesCardDot, false);
            setDot(rentalApplicationsCardDot, false);
            return;
        }

        badgeLoading = true;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            boolean unseenEnquiries = false;
            boolean unseenChatRequests = false;
            boolean unseenNotifications = false;
            boolean unseenRentalApplications = false;
            boolean unseenMessages = false;
            int exactUnreadMessageCount = 0;

            String encodedId = SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/enquiries?select=id&landlord_uid=eq." + encodedId, token);
                unseenEnquiries = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "enquiries", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/chat_requests?select=id&status=eq.pending&receiver_id=eq." + encodedId, token);
                unseenChatRequests = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "chat", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/notifications?select=id&user_uid=eq." + encodedId, token);
                unseenNotifications = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "notifications", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/rental_applications?select=id&status=eq.PENDING&landlord_uid=eq." + encodedId, token);
                unseenRentalApplications = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "rental_applications", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/messages?select=id&receiver_id=eq." + encodedId, token);
                Set<String> seenIds = LandlordNotificationState.seen(getApplicationContext(), "messages", userId);

                for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
                    if (!seenIds.contains(rows.getJSONObject(i).optString("id"))) {
                        exactUnreadMessageCount++;
                    }
                }
                unseenMessages = exactUnreadMessageCount > 0;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            boolean showEnquiries = unseenEnquiries;
            boolean showRentals = unseenRentalApplications;
            boolean showMessages = unseenMessages;
            boolean showMainNotification = unseenEnquiries || unseenChatRequests || unseenNotifications || unseenRentalApplications || unseenMessages;
            int finalMsgCount = exactUnreadMessageCount;

            badgeLoading = false;

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (!dashboardVisible || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                setDot(txtNotificationBadge, showMainNotification);
                setDot(landlordMessageDot, showMessages);
                setDot(enquiriesCardDot, showEnquiries);
                setDot(rentalApplicationsCardDot, showRentals);

                if (txtUnreadMessagesCard != null) {
                    txtUnreadMessagesCard.setText(String.valueOf(finalMsgCount));
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void setDot(View dot, boolean visible) {
        if (dot != null) dot.setVisibility(visible ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    }

    private JSONArray fetchRows(String endpoint, String token) throws Exception {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                return new JSONArray(response);
            }
            return new JSONArray();
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        dashboardVisible = false;
        badgeHandler.removeCallbacks(badgePoll);
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\LandlordNotificationState.java ===


package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public final class LandlordNotificationState {

    private LandlordNotificationState() {
    }

    private static String prefsName(String kind) {
        return "ikhaya_seen_" + kind;
    }

    private static String key(String kind, String userId) {
        return "seen_ids_" + userId;
    }

    public static synchronized Set<String> seen(
            Context context,
            String kind,
            String userId
    ) {
        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                prefsName(kind),
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String raw = prefs.getString(key(kind, userId), "");
        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();

        if (raw != null && !raw.isEmpty()) {
            for (String id : raw.split("\\|")) {
                if (!id.isEmpty()) {
                    ids.add(id);
                }
            }
        }

        return ids;
    }

    public static synchronized boolean hasUnseen(
            Context context,
            String kind,
            String userId,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                prefsName(kind),
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String storageKey = key(kind, userId);

        if (!prefs.contains(storageKey)) {
            markSeen(context, kind, userId, rows);
            return false;
        }

        Set<String> seenIds = seen(context, kind, userId);

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

            if (row == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String id = row.optString("id", "");

            if (!id.isEmpty() && !seenIds.contains(id)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static synchronized void markSeen(
            Context context,
            String kind,
            String userId,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        Set<String> ids = seen(context, kind, userId);

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

            if (row == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String id = row.optString("id", "");

            if (!id.isEmpty()) {
                ids.add(id);
            }
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(
                prefsName(kind),
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        ).edit().putString(
                key(kind, userId),
                TextUtils.join("|", ids)
        ).commit();
    }
}

        open(

                LanguageSettingsActivity.class
        );

        open(
                R.id.btnMyListings,
                MyListingsActivity.class
        );

        open(
                R.id.btnEnquiries,
                EnquiriesActivity.class
        );

        open(
                R.id.btnNotifications,
                NotificationsActivity.class
        );

        open(
                R.id.btnChangePassword,
                ChangePasswordActivity.class
        );

        open(
                R.id.btnReportProblem,
                ReportProblemActivity.class
        );

        Button logout = findViewById(R.id.btnLogout);

        if (logout != null) {
            logout.setOnClickListener(v -> logout());
        }
    }

    private void open(int id, Class<?> destination) {
        Button button = findViewById(id);

        if (button != null) {
            button.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    startActivity(new Intent(this, destination))
            );
        }
    }

    private void logout() {
        try {
            FirebaseAuth.getInstance().signOut();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            android.util.Log.e(
                    "LandlordProfile",
                    "Firebase sign-out failed",
                    e
            );
        }

        try {
            SupabaseHelper.clearSession(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            android.util.Log.e(
                    "LandlordProfile",
                    "Supabase sign-out failed",
                    e
            );
        }

        getSharedPreferences(
                "iKhayaSession",
                MODE_PRIVATE
        ).edit().clear().apply();

        Toast.makeText(
                this,
                R.string.logged_out_successfully,
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
        ).show();

        Intent intent = new Intent(
                this,
                OuterMainActivity.class
        );

        intent.setFlags(
                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                        | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
        );

        startActivity(intent);
        finish();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;


import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.RadioButton;
import android.widget.RadioGroup;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate;
import androidx.core.os.LocaleListCompat;

import java.util.Locale;

public class LanguageSettingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private String selectedLanguageCode = "en";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_language_settings);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        Button btnApply = findViewById(R.id.btnApplyLanguage);
        RadioGroup radioGroup = findViewById(R.id.radioGroupLanguages);

        RadioButton rbEnglish = findViewById(R.id.rbEnglish);
        RadioButton rbZulu = findViewById(R.id.rbZulu);
        RadioButton rbXhosa = findViewById(R.id.rbXhosa);
        RadioButton rbSepedi = findViewById(R.id.rbSepedi);
        RadioButton rbSesotho = findViewById(R.id.rbSesotho);
        RadioButton rbAfrikaans = findViewById(R.id.rbAfrikaans);

        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        // Check the currently active locale radio button
        Locale currentLocale = getResources().getConfiguration().getLocales().get(0);
        String currentLang = currentLocale.getLanguage();
        selectedLanguageCode = currentLang;

        switch (currentLang) {
            case "zu":
                rbZulu.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "xh":
                rbXhosa.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "nso":
                rbSepedi.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "st":
                rbSesotho.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "af":
                rbAfrikaans.setChecked(true);
                break;
            default:
                rbEnglish.setChecked(true);
                break;
        }

        radioGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener((group, checkedId) -> {
            if (checkedId == R.id.rbZulu) {
                selectedLanguageCode = "zu";
            } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbXhosa) {
                selectedLanguageCode = "xh";
            } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbSepedi) {
                selectedLanguageCode = "nso";
            } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbSesotho) {
                selectedLanguageCode = "st";
            } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbAfrikaans) {
                selectedLanguageCode = "af";
            } else {
                selectedLanguageCode = "en";
            }
        });

        btnApply.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            LocaleListCompat appLocale = LocaleListCompat.forLanguageTags(selectedLanguageCode);
            AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales(appLocale);
            finish();
        });
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ListingManager {

    private static final String PREF_NAME = "ikhaya_listings_pref";
    private static final String KEY_LISTINGS = "listings_json_list";

    public static class Listing {
        public String id;
        public String title;
        public String location;
        public String price;
        public String status;

        public Listing(String id, String title, String location,
                       String price, String status) {
            this.id = id;
            this.title = title;
            this.location = location;
            this.price = price;
            this.status = status;
        }

        public JSONObject toJson() {
            JSONObject obj = new JSONObject();
            try {
                obj.put("id", id);
                obj.put("title", title);
                obj.put("location", location);
                obj.put("price", price);
                obj.put("status", status);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
            return obj;
        }

        public static Listing fromJson(JSONObject obj) {
            return new Listing(
                    obj.optString("id", ""),
                    obj.optString("title", "Room Listing"),
                    obj.optString("location", "Location not specified"),
                    obj.optString("price", "Price not specified"),
                    obj.optString("status", "Available")
            );
        }
    }

    public static List<Listing> getListings(Context context) {
        List<Listing> listings = new ArrayList<>();

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREF_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);

        String raw = prefs.getString(KEY_LISTINGS, "[]");

        try {
            JSONArray array = new JSONArray(raw);

            for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject object = array.optJSONObject(i);
                if (object != null) {
                    listings.add(Listing.fromJson(object));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        return listings;
    }

    public static void addListing(Context context, Listing listing) {
        if (listing == null) return;

        List<Listing> current = getListings(context);
        current.add(0, listing);
        saveList(context, current);
    }

    public static void updateListing(Context context, Listing updatedListing) {
        if (updatedListing == null) return;

        List<Listing> current = getListings(context);

        for (int i = 0; i < current.size(); i++) {
            if (current.get(i).id != null
                    && current.get(i).id.equals(updatedListing.id)) {
                current.set(i, updatedListing);
                saveList(context, current);
                return;
            }
        }

        current.add(0, updatedListing);
        saveList(context, current);
    }

    public static void deleteListing(Context context, String listingId) {
        List<Listing> current = getListings(context);

        for (int i = current.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            Listing item = current.get(i);
            if (item.id != null && item.id.equals(listingId)) {
                current.remove(i);
            }
        }

        saveList(context, current);
    }

    private static void saveList(Context context, List<Listing> listings) {
        JSONArray array = new JSONArray();

        for (Listing listing : listings) {
            array.put(listing.toJson());
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(PREF_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .putString(KEY_LISTINGS, array.toString())
                .apply();
    }
}




=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\LoginActivity.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.method.HideReturnsTransformationMethod;
import android.text.method.PasswordTransformationMethod;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class LoginActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private EditText emailInput;
    private EditText passwordInput;
    private Button loginBtn;
    private TextView forgotPasswordText;
    private ImageButton togglePasswordButton;

    private boolean isPasswordVisible = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login);

        ImageButton backButton = findViewById(R.id.back_button);
        emailInput = findViewById(R.id.editTextText);
        passwordInput = findViewById(R.id.editTextText2);
        loginBtn = findViewById(R.id.button2);
        forgotPasswordText = findViewById(R.id.forgotPasswordText);
        togglePasswordButton = findViewById(R.id.btnTogglePassword);

        // Back button navigation
        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, OuterMainActivity.class);
                intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP);
                startActivity(intent);
                finish();
            });
        }

        // Show / Hide password visibility toggle
        if (togglePasswordButton != null && passwordInput != null) {
            togglePasswordButton.setContentDescription("Show password");
            togglePasswordButton.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                int cursorPosition = passwordInput.getSelectionStart();

                if (isPasswordVisible) {
                    passwordInput.setTransformationMethod(PasswordTransformationMethod.getInstance());
                    isPasswordVisible = false;
                    togglePasswordButton.setContentDescription("Show password");
                } else {
                    passwordInput.setTransformationMethod(HideReturnsTransformationMethod.getInstance());
                    isPasswordVisible = true;
                    togglePasswordButton.setContentDescription("Hide password");
                }

                int textLength = passwordInput.getText().length();
                int safeCursorPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(cursorPosition, textLength));
                passwordInput.setSelection(safeCursorPosition);
            });
        }

        // Login button
        if (loginBtn != null) {
            loginBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                String email = emailInput.getText().toString().trim();
                String password = passwordInput.getText().toString();

                if (email.isEmpty()) {
                    emailInput.setError("Enter your email address.");
                    emailInput.requestFocus();
                    return;
                }

                if (password.isEmpty()) {
                    passwordInput.setError("Enter your password.");
                    passwordInput.requestFocus();
                    return;
                }

                loginBtn.setEnabled(false);
                Toast.makeText(this, "Logging in...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                signInWithSupabase(email, password);
            });
        }

        // Forgot password recovery link
        if (forgotPasswordText != null) {
            forgotPasswordText.setOnClickListener(v -> sendPasswordReset());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Signs in using Supabase Auth.
     */
    private void signInWithSupabase(String email, String password) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password",
                        "POST",
                        null
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("email", email);
                body.put("password", password);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                    JSONObject data = new JSONObject(response);
                    String accessToken = data.optString("access_token", "");
                    String refreshToken = data.optString("refresh_token", "");
                    JSONObject user = data.optJSONObject("user");

                    if (accessToken.isEmpty() || user == null) {
                        showLoginError("Login succeeded but no Supabase session was returned.");
                        return;
                    }

                    String userId = user.optString("id", "");
                    if (userId.isEmpty()) {
                        showLoginError("Login failed because no user ID was returned.");
                        return;
                    }

                    // Save session tokens to SharedPreferences
                    getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE)
                            .edit()
                            .putString("access_token", accessToken)
                            .putString("refresh_token", refreshToken)
                            .putString("user_id", userId)
                            .apply();

                    // Query profile and determine routing
                    getUserRole(accessToken, userId);

                } else {
                    showLoginError("Login failed: " + extractErrorMessage(response));
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showLoginError("Could not connect to Supabase: " + e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Sends password-reset recovery email using Supabase Auth.
     */
    private void sendPasswordReset() {
        String email = emailInput.getText().toString().trim();

        if (email.isEmpty()) {
            emailInput.setError("Enter your email address first.");
            emailInput.requestFocus();
            return;
        }

        if (loginBtn != null) {
            loginBtn.setEnabled(false);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/auth/v1/recover",
                        "POST",
                        null
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("email", email);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (loginBtn != null) {
                        loginBtn.setEnabled(true);
                    }

                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        new AlertDialog.Builder(LoginActivity.this)
                                .setTitle("Check your email")
                                .setMessage("If an account exists for this email, a password-reset email will be sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.")
                                .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
                                .show();
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                LoginActivity.this,
                                "Could not request password reset: " + extractErrorMessage(response),
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (loginBtn != null) {
                        loginBtn.setEnabled(true);
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(
                            LoginActivity.this,
                            "Could not connect to request password reset.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Loads the user's role and full name from the profiles table and verifies suspension status.
     */
    private void getUserRole(String accessToken, String userId) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String encodedUserId = URLEncoder.encode(userId, "UTF-8");
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/profiles?select=role,full_name,is_suspended&firebase_uid=eq."
                        + encodedUserId
                        + "&limit=1";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                    JSONArray data = new JSONArray(response);

                    if (data.length() > 0) {
                        JSONObject profile = data.getJSONObject(0);

                        // Block account access if flagged as suspended by an admin
                        boolean isSuspended = profile.optBoolean("is_suspended", false);
                        if (isSuspended) {
                            showLoginError("Your account has been suspended by an administrator. Please contact support.");
                            return;
                        }

                        final String finalRole = profile.optString("role", "tenant");
                        final String finalFullName = profile.optString("full_name", "User");

                        getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE)
                                .edit()
                                .putString("USER_NAME", finalFullName)
                                .putString("USER_ROLE", finalRole)
                                .apply();

                        runOnUiThread(() -> routeUser(finalRole, finalFullName));
                    } else {
                        // Fallback check against the legacy Users table
                        fallbackToUsersTable(userId, accessToken);
                    }
                } else {
                    showLoginError("Could not load account profile: " + extractErrorMessage(response));
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showLoginError("Could not load account profile: " + e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Fallback to query the legacy Users table if profiles row is not found.
     */
    private void fallbackToUsersTable(String userId, String accessToken) {
        try {
            String encodedUserId = URLEncoder.encode(userId, "UTF-8");
            String endpoint = "/rest/v1/Users?select=user_role,firstName,surname,is_suspended&id=eq." + encodedUserId + "&limit=1";

            HttpURLConnection conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);
            int code = conn.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                JSONArray data = new JSONArray(response);
                if (data.length() > 0) {
                    JSONObject userObj = data.getJSONObject(0);

                    boolean isSuspended = userObj.optBoolean("is_suspended", false);
                    if (isSuspended) {
                        showLoginError("Your account has been suspended by an administrator. Please contact support.");
                        conn.disconnect();
                        return;
                    }

                    final String finalRole = userObj.optString("user_role", "tenant");
                    String firstName = userObj.optString("firstName", "");
                    String surname = userObj.optString("surname", "");
                    String rawName = (firstName + " " + surname).trim();
                    final String finalFullName = rawName.isEmpty() ? "User" : rawName;

                    getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE)
                            .edit()
                            .putString("USER_NAME", finalFullName)
                            .putString("USER_ROLE", finalRole)
                            .apply();

                    runOnUiThread(() -> routeUser(finalRole, finalFullName));
                } else {
                    showLoginError("Your account profile was not found in either table.");
                }
            } else {
                showLoginError("Could not load fallback profile: " + extractErrorMessage(response));
            }
            conn.disconnect();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            showLoginError("Could not load fallback profile: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Routes the user to their respective dashboard based on their role.
     * Passes the user's full name to AdminDashboardActivity so the header greets them personally.
     */
    private void routeUser(String role, String fullName) {
        Intent intent;

        if ("landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)) {
            intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, LandlordDashboardActivity.class);
        } else if ("admin".equalsIgnoreCase(role)) {
            intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, AdminDashboardActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("USER_ROLE", "ADMIN");
            intent.putExtra("USER_NAME", fullName);
        } else {
            intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, HomeActivity.class);
        }

        intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        AnalyticsHelper.logLogin(this, role);
        startActivity(intent);
        finish();
    }

    private void showLoginError(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (loginBtn != null) {
                loginBtn.setEnabled(true);
            }
            Toast.makeText(LoginActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
    }

    private String extractErrorMessage(String response) {
        try {
            JSONObject error = new JSONObject(response);
            String message = error.optString("msg", "");
            if (message.isEmpty()) message = error.optString("message", "");
            if (message.isEmpty()) message = error.optString("error_description", "");
            if (message.isEmpty()) message = error.optString("error", "");
            if (!message.isEmpty()) return message;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return (response == null || response.trim().isEmpty()) ? "Unknown error" : response;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;

import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class MyListingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private LinearLayout listingsContainer;
    private TextView txtNoListings;
    private final ExecutorService executor =
            Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> editListingLauncher =
            registerForActivityResult(
                    new ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult(),
                    result -> loadMyListings()
            );

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_my_listings);

        listingsContainer = findViewById(R.id.myListingsContainer);
        txtNoListings = findViewById(R.id.txtNoListings);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        loadMyListings();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();

        if (listingsContainer != null) {
            loadMyListings();
        }
    }

    private void loadMyListings() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty()
                || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        txtNoListings.setText("Loading your listings...");
        txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings"
                        + "?select=*"
                        + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                        + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                        + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint, "GET", token
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    showMessage("Could not load listings. Supabase error: " + code);
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray listings = new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    listingsContainer.removeAllViews();

                    if (listings.length() == 0) {
                        txtNoListings.setText("You haven't added any listings yet.");
                        txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        return;
                    }

                    txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                    for (int i = 0; i < listings.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject listing = listings.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (listing != null) {
                            addListingCard(listing);
                        }
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage("Could not load listings. Please try again.");
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void addListingCard(JSONObject listing) {
        View card = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(
                R.layout.item_listing,
                listingsContainer,
                false
        );

        ImageView imgListing = card.findViewById(R.id.imgListing);
        TextView txtListingName = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingName);
        TextView txtListingLocation = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingLocation);
        TextView txtListingPrice = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingPrice);
        TextView txtListingRooms = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingRooms);
        Button btnEditListing = card.findViewById(R.id.btnEditListing);
        Button btnDeleteListing = card.findViewById(R.id.btnDeleteListing);

        String listingId = listing.optString("id", "");
        String propertyName = firstValue(
                listing, "property_name", "title", "name"
        );
        String location = firstValue(
                listing, "location", "address", "area"
        );
        String price = firstValue(listing, "price", "monthly_price");
        String rooms = firstValue(
                listing, "rooms", "bedrooms", "room_count"
        );
        String imageUrl = firstValue(
                listing,
                "image_url",
                "image",
                "image_path",
                "photo_url",
                "property_image",
                "imageUrl",
                "cover_image",
                "photo"
        );

        if (propertyName.isEmpty()) propertyName = "Property";
        if (location.isEmpty()) location = "Location not provided";
        if (price.isEmpty()) price = "0";
        if (rooms.isEmpty()) rooms = "Not specified";

        txtListingName.setText(propertyName);
        txtListingLocation.setText(location);
        txtListingPrice.setText("R" + price + " / month");
        txtListingRooms.setText(rooms + " rooms");

        imgListing.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery);
        imgListing.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);

        if (!imageUrl.isEmpty()) {
            loadListingImage(imageUrl, imgListing);
        }

        String finalPropertyName = propertyName;

        btnEditListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listingId.isEmpty()) {
                showMessage("Listing ID is missing.");
                return;
            }

            Intent intent = new Intent(
                    MyListingsActivity.this,
                    EditListingActivity.class
            );

            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listingId);
            intent.putExtra("listingId", listingId);
            intent.putExtra("propertyName", finalPropertyName);

            editListingLauncher.launch(intent);
        });

        btnDeleteListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listingId.isEmpty()) {
                showMessage("Listing ID is missing.");
                return;
            }

            new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle("Delete listing?")
                    .setMessage("Delete \"" + finalPropertyName + "\"?")
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .setPositiveButton("Delete", (dialog, which) ->
                            deleteListing(listingId))
                    .show();
        });

        listingsContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private String firstValue(JSONObject object, String... keys) {
        for (String key : keys) {
            Object value = object.opt(key);

            if (value != null && value != JSONObject.NULL) {
                String result = String.valueOf(value).trim();

                if (!result.isEmpty()
                        && !result.equalsIgnoreCase("null")) {
                    return result;
                }
            }
        }

        return "";
    }

    private void loadListingImage(String imageUrl, ImageView imageView) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                if (!imageUrl.startsWith("https://")
                        && !imageUrl.startsWith("http://")) {
                    return;
                }

                connection = (HttpURLConnection)
                        new URL(imageUrl).openConnection();

                connection.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(15000);
                connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                connection.connect();

                if (connection.getResponseCode() < 200
                        || connection.getResponseCode() >= 300) {
                    return;
                }

                try (InputStream input = connection.getInputStream()) {
                    Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input);

                    if (bitmap != null && !isFinishing()) {
                        runOnUiThread(() -> {
                            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                                imageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }

            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                // Keep the placeholder if the image URL cannot be loaded.
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void deleteListing(String listingId) {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty()
                || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings"
                        + "?id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId)
                        + "&landlord_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint, "DELETE", token
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    showMessage("Listing deleted.");
                    loadMyListings();
                } else {
                    showMessage("Could not delete listing. Supabase error: " + code);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage("Could not delete listing. Please try again.");
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() ->
                Toast.makeText(
                        MyListingsActivity.this,
                        message,
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                ).show()
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

public class NotificationsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private LinearLayout notificationsListContainer;

    private void loadUnseenEnquiries() {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/enquiries?select=id"
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray rows = new JSONArray(response);

                Set<String> seen = LandlordNotificationState.seen(
                        this,
                        "enquiries",
                        userId
                );

                int unseen = 0;

                for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

                    if (row != null) {
                        String id = row.optString("id", "");

                        if (!id.isEmpty() && !seen.contains(id)) {
                            unseen++;
                        }
                    }
                }

                final int count = unseen;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()
                            || pendingRequestsContainer == null) {
                        return;
                    }

                    // Remove the previous enquiry shortcut, if present.
                    android.view.View previous =
                            pendingRequestsContainer.findViewWithTag(
                                    "unseen_enquiries_shortcut"
                            );

                    if (previous != null) {
                        pendingRequestsContainer.removeView(previous);
                    }

                    if (count == 0) {
                        return;
                    }

                    Button enquiries = new Button(this);

                    enquiries.setTag("unseen_enquiries_shortcut");
                    enquiries.setAllCaps(false);

                    enquiries.setText(
                            getString(
                                    R.string.unseen_enquiries_count,
                                    count
                            )
                    );

                    enquiries.setBackgroundResource(
                            R.drawable.selector_regular_button
                    );

                    enquiries.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);

                    enquiries.setOnClickListener(v ->
                            startActivity(new Intent(
                                    this,
                                    EnquiriesActivity.class
                            ))
                    );

                    pendingRequestsContainer.addView(enquiries, 0);
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                android.util.Log.w(
                        "Notifications",
                        "Unable to check new enquiries",
                        e
                );

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadPendingChatRequests() {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/chat_requests"
                                + "?receiver_id=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                                + "&status=eq.pending"
                                + "&order=created_at.desc";

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray requests = new JSONArray(response);

                    runOnUiThread(() ->
                            renderPendingRequests(requests)
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage(R.string.error_loading_chat_requests);

            } finally {
                if (conn != null) {
                    conn.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderPendingRequests(JSONArray requests) {
        if (pendingRequestsContainer == null) {
            return;
        }

        pendingRequestsContainer.removeAllViews();

        LandlordNotificationState.markSeen(
                this,
                "chat",
                userId,

        );

        if (requests.length() == 0) {

        for (int i = 0; i < requests.length(); i++) {

            if (request != null) {

            }
        }

    private void renderRequestCard(JSONObject request) {

                )

        body.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));

        actions.setPadding(0, dp(10), 0, 0);

        Button accept = new Button(this);
        accept.setText(R.string.accept);
        accept.setAllCaps(false);
        accept.setBackgroundResource(
                R.drawable.selector_regular_button
        );
        accept.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams acceptParams =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        0,

                );

        acceptParams.setMarginEnd(dp(5));
        accept.setLayoutParams(acceptParams);

        Button decline = new Button(this);
        decline.setText(R.string.decline);
        decline.setAllCaps(false);
        decline.setBackgroundResource(
                R.drawable.selector_regular_button
        );
        decline.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams declineParams =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
