    private void updateRequestStatus(
            JSONObject fullRow,
            String newStatus,
            CardView card,
            String targetUserId,
            String targetName,
            Button acceptButton,
            Button declineButton) {

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;

            try {
                // Preserve the existing chat-request update approach.
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/chat_requests?on_conflict=id",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                conn.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal"
                );

                JSONObject updatedRow =
                        new JSONObject(fullRow.toString());

                updatedRow.put("status", newStatus);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(conn, updatedRow);

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        pendingRequestsContainer.removeView(card);

                        if ("accepted".equals(newStatus)) {
                            Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    R.string.chat_request_accepted,
                                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                            ).show();

                            Intent intent = new Intent(
                                    this,
                                    ChatActivity.class
                            );

                            intent.putExtra(
                                    "RECEIVER_ID",
                                    targetUserId
                            );

                            intent.putExtra(
                                    "RECEIVER_NAME",
                                    targetName
                            );

                            intent.putExtra(
                                    "IS_COMMUNITY",
                                    false
                            );

                            android.content.SharedPreferences prefs =
                                    getSharedPreferences(
                                            "iKhayaSession",
                                            MODE_PRIVATE
                                    );

                            intent.putExtra(
                                    "SENDER_ID",
                                    userId
                            );

                            intent.putExtra(
                                    "SENDER_NAME",
                                    prefs.getString(
                                            "USER_NAME",
                                            getString(
                                                    R.string.notification_user
                                            )
                                    )
                            );

                            intent.putExtra(
                                    "SENDER_ROLE",
                                    prefs.getString(
                                            "USER_ROLE",
                                            getString(
                                                    R.string.notification_member
                                            )
                                    )
                            );

                            startActivity(intent);

                        } else {
                            Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    R.string.chat_request_declined,
                                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                            ).show();
                        }
                    });

                } else {
                    String error = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                    android.util.Log.e(
                            "Notifications",
                            "Chat request update failed: " + error
                    );

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        acceptButton.setEnabled(true);
                        declineButton.setEnabled(true);

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                R.string.chat_request_update_failed,
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    });
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                android.util.Log.e(
                        "Notifications",
                        "Error updating chat request",
                        e
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    acceptButton.setEnabled(true);
                    declineButton.setEnabled(true);

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            R.string.chat_request_update_failed,
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (conn != null) {
                    conn.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadNotifications() {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/notifications"
                                + "?select=*"
                                + "&user_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                                + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    showMessage(
                            R.string.could_not_load_notifications
                    );
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray notifications = new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()
                            || notificationsListContainer == null) {
                        return;
                    }

                    notificationsListContainer.removeAllViews();

                    for (int i = 0; i < notifications.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject notification =
                                notifications.optJSONObject(i);

                        if (notification != null) {
                            renderNotificationCard(notification);
                        }
                    }

                    if (notifications.length() == 0) {
                        TextView empty = new TextView(this);

                        empty.setText(
                                R.string.no_general_notifications
                        );

                        empty.setTextSize(15f);
                        empty.setTextColor(
                                Color.parseColor("#756763")
                        );

                        notificationsListContainer.addView(empty);
                    }

                    // Mark only successfully displayed notifications as seen.
                    LandlordNotificationState.markSeen(
                            this,
                            "notifications",
                            userId,
                            notifications
                    );
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                android.util.Log.e(
                        "Notifications",
                        "Could not load notifications",
                        e
                );

                showMessage(
                        R.string.could_not_load_notifications
                );

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderNotificationCard(JSONObject notification) {
        String title = notification.optString(
                "title",
                getString(R.string.notifications)
        );

        String message = notification.optString("message", "");

        CardView card = new CardView(this);

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );

        params.bottomMargin = dp(12);

        card.setLayoutParams(params);
        card.setRadius(dp(12));
        card.setCardElevation(dp(2));
        card.setCardBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE);

        LinearLayout inner = new LinearLayout(this);
        inner.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        inner.setPadding(dp(16), dp(14), dp(16), dp(14));

        TextView titleView = new TextView(this);

        titleView.setText(title);
        titleView.setTextSize(16f);
        titleView.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        titleView.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));

        TextView messageView = new TextView(this);

        messageView.setText(message);
        messageView.setTextSize(14f);
        messageView.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#756763"));
        messageView.setPadding(0, dp(4), 0, 0);

        inner.addView(titleView);
        inner.addView(messageView);

        card.addView(inner);
        notificationsListContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private void showMessage(int messageResource) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                Toast.makeText(
                        this,
                        messageResource,
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show();
            }
        });
    }

    private int dp(int value) {
        return (int) (
                value * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density
                        + 0.5f
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

public class OtpActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private EditText otp1, otp2, otp3, otp4, otp5;
    private Button verifyBtn;

    // Our mock demo code
    private static final String MOCK_OTP = "12345";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_otp);

        // 1. Back Button Logic
        ImageButton backButton = findViewById(R.id.back_button);
        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        // 2. Link XML to Java
        otp1 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_1);
        otp2 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_2);
        otp3 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_3);
        otp4 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_4);
        otp5 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_5);
        verifyBtn = findViewById(R.id.button);

        // Retrieve data passed from RegistrationActivity
        Intent incomingIntent = getIntent();
        String username = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_NAME");
        String surname = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_SURNAME");
        String phone = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_PHONE");
        String email = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_EMAIL");
        String role = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_ROLE");

        // 3. Set up the auto-jumping logic
        setupOtpJumps(otp1, otp2);
        setupOtpJumps(otp2, otp3);
        setupOtpJumps(otp3, otp4);
        setupOtpJumps(otp4, otp5);
        setupOtpJumps(otp5, null); // null means it's the last box

        // 4. Button Click Logic
        verifyBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Combine all 5 boxes into one string
            String enteredCode = otp1.getText().toString() +
                    otp2.getText().toString() +
                    otp3.getText().toString() +
                    otp4.getText().toString() +
                    otp5.getText().toString();

            if (enteredCode.equals(MOCK_OTP)) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Verified successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();

                // Move to CreatePasswordActivity and forward user registration info
                Intent intent = new Intent(OtpActivity.this, CreatePasswordActivity.class);
                intent.putExtra("USER_NAME", username);
                intent.putExtra("USER_SURNAME", surname);
                intent.putExtra("USER_PHONE", phone);
                intent.putExtra("USER_EMAIL", email);
                intent.putExtra("USER_ROLE", role);
                startActivity(intent);

            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid code! Use 12345", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
        });
    }

    // Helper method to automatically jump to the next box
    private void setupOtpJumps(EditText currentBox, EditText nextBox) {
        currentBox.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {}

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {
                if (s.length() == 1) {
                    if (nextBox != null) {
                        nextBox.requestFocus();
                    } else {
                        currentBox.clearFocus();
                        InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager) getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
                        if (imm != null) {
                            imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(currentBox.getWindowToken(), 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

        java.util.function.Consumer<Button> highlightButton = (activeBtn) -> {
            for (Button b : langButtons) {
                if (b != null) {
                    boolean isActive = (b == activeBtn);
                    b.setBackgroundTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(isActive ? activeColor : inactiveColor));
                    b.setTextColor(isActive ? android.graphics.Color.WHITE : android.graphics.Color.BLACK);

            selectedLanguage = "Afrikaans";
            highlightButton.accept(btnAfrikaans);

            highlightButton.accept(btnSepedi);
        } else if ("st".equals(currentLang)) {

            highlightButton.accept(btnSesotho);
        } else if ("zu".equals(currentLang)) {
            selectedLanguage = "isiZulu";
            highlightButton.accept(btnIsiZulu);
        } else {
            selectedLanguage = "English";
            highlightButton.accept(btnEnglish);
        }

        // 3. Click listener to change language dynamically
        View.OnClickListener languageClickListener = v -> {
            highlightButton.accept((Button) v);

            String tag = "en";
            int id = v.getId();
            if (id == R.id.English_btn) {
                selectedLanguage = "English";

                selectedLanguage = "Afrikaans";

            } else if (id == R.id.sepedi_btn) {
                selectedLanguage = "Sepedi";
                tag = "nso";
            } else if (id == R.id.sesotho_btn) {
                selectedLanguage = "Sesotho";
                tag = "st";
            } else if (id == R.id.isiZulu_btn) {
                selectedLanguage = "isiZulu";
                tag = "zu";
            }

            LocaleListCompat appLocale = LocaleListCompat.forLanguageTags(tag);
            AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales(appLocale);
        };

        if (btnEnglish != null) btnEnglish.setOnClickListener(languageClickListener);
        if (btnIsiXhosa != null) btnIsiXhosa.setOnClickListener(languageClickListener);

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONArray;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;

public class PaymentHistoryActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextView txtNoPayments;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_payment_history);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        txtNoPayments = findViewById(R.id.txtNoPayments);

        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        loadPaymentHistory();
    }

    private void loadPaymentHistory() {

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || accessToken == null) {
            return;
        }

        new Thread(() -> {

            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {

                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/payments" +
                                "?select=*" +
                                "&tenant_uid=eq." +
                                SupabaseHelper.encode(userId) +
                                "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                JSONArray payments =
                        new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {

                    if (payments.length() > 0) {

                        txtNoPayments.setText(
                                payments.length() +
                                        " payment record(s) found."
                        );

                    } else {

                        txtNoPayments.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {

                runOnUiThread(() ->
                        Toast.makeText(
                                PaymentHistoryActivity.this,
                                "Could not load payment history.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show()
                );

            } finally {

                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }

        }).start();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.location.Address;
import android.location.Geocoder;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;

import com.google.android.gms.location.FusedLocationProviderClient;
import com.google.android.gms.location.LocationServices;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class PersonalActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private EditText idInput;
    private EditText provinceInput;
    private EditText cityInput;
    private EditText suburbInput;

    private Button registerBtn;
    private Button gpsBtn;

    private FusedLocationProviderClient fusedLocationClient;
    private Geocoder geocoder;

    private final ExecutorService executorService =
            Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> locationPermissionRequest =
            registerForActivityResult(
                    new ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions(),
                    result -> {

                        boolean fineLocationGranted =
                                Boolean.TRUE.equals(
                                        result.getOrDefault(
                                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                                                false
                                        )
                                );

                        boolean coarseLocationGranted =
                                Boolean.TRUE.equals(
                                        result.getOrDefault(
                                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION,
                                                false
                                        )
                                );

                        if (fineLocationGranted
                                || coarseLocationGranted) {

                            fetchLocation();

                        } else {

                            Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    "Location permission denied. Cannot fetch GPS.",
                                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                            ).show();
                        }
                    }
            );

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {

        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        setContentView(
                R.layout.activity_userverification
        );

        fusedLocationClient =
                LocationServices.getFusedLocationProviderClient(this);

        geocoder =
                new Geocoder(
                        this,
                        Locale.getDefault()
                );

        idInput =
                findViewById(R.id.idNum);

        provinceInput =
                findViewById(R.id.provinceInputText);

        cityInput =
                findViewById(R.id.cityInputText);

        suburbInput =
                findViewById(R.id.suburbInputText);

        registerBtn =
                findViewById(R.id.registrationBtn);

        gpsBtn =
                findViewById(R.id.GPSbtn);

        ImageButton backButton =
                findViewById(R.id.back_button);

        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(
                    v -> finish()
            );
        }

        if (gpsBtn != null) {

            gpsBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {

                boolean fineGranted =
                        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                                this,
                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
                        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;

                boolean coarseGranted =
                        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                                this,
                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
                        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;

                if (fineGranted || coarseGranted) {

                    fetchLocation();

                } else {

                    locationPermissionRequest.launch(
                            new String[]{
                                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
                            }
                    );
                }
            });
        }

        if (registerBtn != null) {

            registerBtn.setOnClickListener(
                    v -> registerUser()
            );
        }
    }

    private void registerUser() {

        String enteredId =
                idInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        String province =
                provinceInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        String city =
                cityInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        String suburb =
                suburbInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        if (enteredId.isEmpty()
                || province.isEmpty()
                || city.isEmpty()
                || suburb.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please fill in all fields",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if (!province.matches("[a-zA-Z\\s-]+")) {

            provinceInput.setError(
                    "Please enter a valid province name"
            );

            return;
        }

        if (!city.matches("[a-zA-Z\\s-]+")) {

            cityInput.setError(
                    "Please enter a valid city name"
            );

            return;
        }

        if (!suburb.matches("[a-zA-Z0-9\\s-]+")) {

            suburbInput.setError(
                    "Please enter a valid suburb name"
            );

            return;
        }

        String role =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_ROLE"
                );

        if (role == null) {
            role = "Resident";
        }

        if (!IdSecurityHelper.isValidLuhn(enteredId)) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Invalid ID Number format detected.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        int age =
                IdSecurityHelper.getAgeAndValidateDate(
                        enteredId
                );

        if (age == -1) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Invalid Date of Birth in ID.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if ("Landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)
                && age < 18) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Landlords must be 18 or older.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        String email =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_EMAIL"
                );

        String password =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_PASSWORD"
                );

        String firstName =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_NAME"
                );

        String surname =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_SURNAME"
                );

        String phone =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_PHONE"
                );

        if (email == null
                || password == null
                || email.isEmpty()
                || password.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Missing account details. Please restart registration.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if (firstName == null) {
            firstName = "";
        }

        if (surname == null) {
            surname = "";
        }

        if (phone == null) {
            phone = "";
        }

        registerBtn.setEnabled(false);

        final String finalRole =
                "Landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)
                        ? "landlord"
                        : "tenant";

        createSupabaseAccount(
                email,
                password,
                firstName,
                surname,
                phone,
                finalRole,
                province,
                city,
                suburb
        );
    }

    private void createSupabaseAccount(
            String email,
            String password,
            String firstName,
            String surname,
            String phone,
            String role,
            String province,
            String city,
            String suburb
    ) {

        executorService.execute(() -> {

            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {

                connection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                "/auth/v1/signup",
                                "POST",
                                null
                        );

                connection.setDoOutput(true);

                JSONObject body =
                        new JSONObject();

                body.put(
                        "email",
                        email
                );

                body.put(
                        "password",
                        password
                );

                JSONObject metadata =
                        new JSONObject();

                metadata.put(
                        "first_name",
                        firstName
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "surname",
                        surname
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "phone",
                        phone
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "role",
                        role
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "province",
                        province
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "city",
                        city
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "suburb",
                        suburb
                );

                body.put(
                        "data",
                        metadata
                );

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(
                        connection,
                        body
                );

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(
                                connection
                        );

                if (responseCode >= 200
                        && responseCode < 300) {

                    JSONObject data =
                            new JSONObject(response);

                    String accessToken =
                            data.optString(
                                    "access_token",
                                    ""
                            );

                    String refreshToken =
                            data.optString(
                                    "refresh_token",
                                    ""
                            );

                    JSONObject user =
                            data.optJSONObject("user");

                    if (user == null) {

                        showRegistrationError(
                                "Account creation failed: no user was returned."
                        );

                        return;
                    }

                    String userId =
                            user.optString(
                                    "id",
                                    ""
                            );

                    if (userId.isEmpty()) {

                        showRegistrationError(
                                "Account creation failed: no user ID was returned."
                        );

                        return;
                    }

                    if (accessToken.isEmpty()) {

                        runOnUiThread(() -> {

                            registerBtn.setEnabled(true);

                            Toast.makeText(
                                    PersonalActivity.this,
                                    "Account created. Please confirm your email, then log in.",
                                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                            ).show();

                            Intent intent =
                                    new Intent(
                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                            LoginActivity.class
                                    );

                            intent.setFlags(
                                    Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK |
                                            Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
                            );

                            startActivity(intent);
                            finish();
                        });

                        return;
                    }

                    getSharedPreferences(
                            "iKhayaSession",
                            MODE_PRIVATE
                    )
                            .edit()
                            .putString(
                                    "access_token",
                                    accessToken
                            )
                            .putString(
                                    "refresh_token",
                                    refreshToken
                            )
                            .putString(
                                    "user_id",
                                    userId
                            )
                            .apply();

                    saveProfile(
                            accessToken,
                            userId,
                            role,
                            firstName,
                            surname,
                            phone
                    );

                } else {

                    showRegistrationError(
                            "Supabase registration error: "
                                    + responseCode
                                    + "\n"
                                    + extractErrorMessage(response)
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {

                Log.e(
                        "iKhayaSupabase",
                        "Supabase registration failed",
                        e
                );

                showRegistrationError(
                        "Database Error: "
                                + e.getMessage()
                );

            } finally {

                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void saveProfile(
            String accessToken,
            String userId,
            String role,
            String firstName,
            String surname,
            String phone
    ) {

        executorService.execute(() -> {

            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {

                connection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                "/rest/v1/profiles",
                                "POST",
                                accessToken
                        );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "return=minimal"
                );

                connection.setDoOutput(true);

                JSONObject profile =
                        new JSONObject();

                profile.put(
                        "firebase_uid",
                        userId
                );

                String fullName =
                        (firstName + " " + surname).trim();

                profile.put(
                        "full_name",
                        fullName
                );

                profile.put(
                        "phone",
                        phone
                );

                profile.put(
                        "role",
                        role
                );

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(
                        connection,
                        profile
                );

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(
                                connection
                        );

                if (responseCode >= 200
                        && responseCode < 300) {

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {

                        getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE)
                                .edit()
                                .putString("USER_NAME", fullName)
                                .putString("USER_ROLE", role)
                                .apply();

                        Toast.makeText(
                                PersonalActivity.this,
                                "Registration Successful!",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show();

                        Intent intent;

                        if ("landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)) {

                            intent =
                                    new Intent(
                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                            LandlordDashboardActivity.class
                                    );

                        } else {

                            intent =
                                    new Intent(
                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                            HomeActivity.class
                                    );
                        }

                        intent.setFlags(
                                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK |
                                        Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
                        );

                        startActivity(intent);
                        finish();
                    });

                } else {

                    showRegistrationError(
                            "Profile database error: "
                                    + responseCode
                                    + "\n"
                                    + extractErrorMessage(response)
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {

                Log.e(
                        "iKhayaSupabase",
                        "Profile creation failed",
                        e
                );

                showRegistrationError(
                        "Profile database error: "
                                + e.getMessage()
                );

            } finally {

                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showRegistrationError(String message) {

        runOnUiThread(() -> {

            registerBtn.setEnabled(true);

            Toast.makeText(
                    PersonalActivity.this,
                    message,
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
        });
    }

    private String extractErrorMessage(String response) {

        try {

            JSONObject error =
                    new JSONObject(response);

            String message =
                    error.optString(
                            "msg",
                            ""
                    );

            if (message.isEmpty()) {
                message =
                        error.optString(
                                "message",
                                ""
                        );
            }

            if (message.isEmpty()) {
                message =
                        error.optString(
                                "error_description",
                                ""
                        );
            }

            if (!message.isEmpty()) {
                return message;
            }

        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        return response.isEmpty()
                ? "Unknown error"
                : response;
    }

    private void fetchLocation() {

        try {

            fusedLocationClient
                    .getLastLocation()
                    .addOnSuccessListener(
                            this,
                            location -> {

                                if (location != null) {

                                    Toast.makeText(
                                            this,
                                            "Location found! Resolving address...",
                                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                                    ).show();

                                    executorService.execute(() -> {

                                        try {

                                            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT
                                                    >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {

                                                geocoder.getFromLocation(
                                                        location.getLatitude(),
                                                        location.getLongitude(),
                                                        1,
                                                        this::handleAddresses
                                                );

                                            } else {

                                                List<Address> addresses =
                                                        geocoder.getFromLocation(
                                                                location.getLatitude(),
                                                                location.getLongitude(),
                                                                1
                                                        );

                                                handleAddresses(
                                                        addresses
                                                );
                                            }

                                        } catch (IOException e) {

                                            runOnUiThread(
                                                    () -> Toast.makeText(
                                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                                            "Network error while resolving address.",
                                                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                                                    ).show()
                                            );
                                        }
                                    });

                                } else {

                                    Toast.makeText(
                                            this,
                                            "Current location is unavailable.",
                                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                                    ).show();
                                }
                            }
                    )
                    .addOnFailureListener(
                            this,
                            e -> Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    "Error fetching location: "
                                            + e.getMessage(),
                                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                            ).show()
                    );

        } catch (SecurityException e) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Location permission is required.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();
        }
    }

    private void handleAddresses(
            List<Address> addresses
    ) {

        if (addresses != null
                && !addresses.isEmpty()) {

            Address address =
                    addresses.get(0);

            String province =
                    address.getAdminArea();

            String city =
                    address.getLocality();

            if (city == null) {
                city =
                        address.getSubAdminArea();
            }

            String suburb =
                    address.getSubLocality();

            final String finalProvince =
                    province != null
                            ? province
                            : "";

            final String finalCity =
                    city != null
                            ? city
                            : "";

            final String finalSuburb =
                    suburb != null
                            ? suburb
                            : "";

            runOnUiThread(() -> {

                provinceInput.setText(
                        finalProvince
                );

                cityInput.setText(
                        finalCity
                );

                suburbInput.setText(
                        finalSuburb
                );

                Toast.makeText(
                        PersonalActivity.this,
                        "Address updated!",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show();
            });

        } else {

            runOnUiThread(
                    () -> Toast.makeText(
                            PersonalActivity.this,
                            "Could not find a physical address for this location.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {

        super.onDestroy();

        executorService.shutdown();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.view.View;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

public class PersonalInformationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextView txtName;
    private TextView txtEmail;
    private TextView txtPhone;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_personal_information);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);

        txtName = findViewById(R.id.txtName);
        txtEmail = findViewById(R.id.txtEmail);
        txtPhone = findViewById(R.id.txtPhone);

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        showLoading();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        loadInformation();
    }

    private void showLoading() {
        if (txtName != null) {
            txtName.setText("Loading...");
        }

        if (txtEmail != null) {
            txtEmail.setText("Loading...");
        }

        if (txtPhone != null) {
            txtPhone.setText("Loading...");
        }
    }

    private void loadInformation() {
        UserProfileLoader.load(this, (name, email, phone) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }

            if (txtName != null) {
                txtName.setText(
                        name.isEmpty() ? "Not provided" : name
                );
            }

            if (txtEmail != null) {
                txtEmail.setText(
                        email.isEmpty() ? "Not provided" : email
                );
            }

            if (txtPhone != null) {
                txtPhone.setText(
                        phone.isEmpty() ? "Not provided" : phone
                );
            }
        });
    }
}

    private void setupChipsAndDescription() {
        if (chipGroupAmenities != null) {
            chipGroupAmenities.removeAllViews();
        }

        if (chipGroupRules != null) {
            chipGroupRules.removeAllViews();
        }

        if (propertyDescription != null) {
            propertyDescription.setText("");
        }

        Locale currentLocale = getResources().getConfiguration().getLocales().get(0);
        String currentLang = currentLocale.getLanguage();

        if (btnTranslate != null) {
            btnTranslate.setVisibility(View.GONE);

            btnTranslate.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (originalDescription.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    showFormError(R.string.description_not_available);
                    return;
                }

                if (isTranslated) {
                    if (txtPropertyName != null) {
                        txtPropertyName.setText(propertyName);
                    }
                    if (propertyDescription != null) {
                        propertyDescription.setText(originalDescription);
                    }
                    btnTranslate.setText(getString(R.string.translate_to_language, getLanguageDisplayName(currentLang)));
                    isTranslated = false;
                    return;
                }

                if (!cachedTranslatedDescription.isEmpty()) {
                    String[] parts = cachedTranslatedDescription.split(" ::: ");
                    if (parts.length >= 2) {
                        if (txtPropertyName != null) {
                            txtPropertyName.setText(parts[0].trim());
                        }
                        if (propertyDescription != null) {
                            propertyDescription.setText(parts[1].trim());
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (propertyDescription != null) {
                            propertyDescription.setText(cachedTranslatedDescription);
                        }
                    }
                    btnTranslate.setText(R.string.show_original);
                    isTranslated = true;
                    return;
                }

                if (progressTranslate != null) {
                    progressTranslate.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                }

                btnTranslate.setEnabled(false);

                String textToTranslate = propertyName + " ::: " + originalDescription;

                GeminiTranslator.translate(
                        textToTranslate,
                        currentLang,
                        new GeminiTranslator.TranslationCallback() {
                            @Override
                            public void onSuccess(String result) {
                                if (progressTranslate != null) {
                                    progressTranslate.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                                }
                                btnTranslate.setEnabled(true);
                                cachedTranslatedDescription = result;

                                String[] parts = result.split(" ::: ");
                                if (parts.length >= 2) {
                                    if (txtPropertyName != null) {
                                        txtPropertyName.setText(parts[0].trim());
                                    }
                                    if (propertyDescription != null) {
                                        propertyDescription.setText(parts[1].trim());
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    if (propertyDescription != null) {
                                        propertyDescription.setText(result);
                                    }
                                }
                                btnTranslate.setText(R.string.show_original);
                                isTranslated = true;
                            }

                            @Override
                            public void onError(String errorMessage) {
                                if (progressTranslate != null) {
                                    progressTranslate.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                                }
                                btnTranslate.setEnabled(true);
                                Toast.makeText(PropertyDetailsActivity.this,
                                        getString(R.string.translation_failed, errorMessage),
                                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            }
                        }
                );
            });
        }
    }

    private void populateChipGroup(ChipGroup group, Object rawValues) {
        if (group == null || rawValues == null || rawValues == JSONObject.NULL) {
            return;
        }

        group.removeAllViews();

        if (rawValues instanceof JSONArray) {
            JSONArray values = (JSONArray) rawValues;
            for (int i = 0; i < values.length(); i++) {
                addChip(group, values.optString(i, ""));
            }
        } else {
            String raw = String.valueOf(rawValues).trim();
            if (raw.isEmpty() || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(raw)) {
                return;
            }

            for (String part : raw.split(",")) {
                addChip(group, part);
            }
        }
    }

    private void addChip(ChipGroup group, String value) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        Chip chip = new Chip(this);
        chip.setText(value.trim());
        chip.setClickable(false);
        chip.setCheckable(false);
        chip.setChipBackgroundColor(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor("#FFFFFF")));
        chip.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
        chip.setTextSize(12);
        group.addView(chip);
    }
