            if (btnApplyToRent != null) btnApplyToRent.setVisibility(View.GONE);

            if (btnEditListing != null) {
                btnEditListing.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                btnEditListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    Intent editIntent = new Intent(this, AddListingActivity.class);
                    editIntent.putExtra("isEditing", true);
                    editIntent.putExtra("listingId", listingId);
                    editIntent.putExtra("propertyName", propertyName);
                    startActivity(editIntent);
                });
            }
        } else {
            if (btnContactLandlord != null) btnContactLandlord.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            if (btnEditListing != null) btnEditListing.setVisibility(View.GONE);

            if (btnApplyToRent != null) {
                btnApplyToRent.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                updateActionButtonsForOffering();
            }
        }
    }

    private void updateActionButtonsForOffering() {
        if (btnApplyToRent == null) return;

        if (isForSale) {
            btnApplyToRent.setText(R.string.btn_book_site_visit);
            if (tvTermsSubtitle != null) tvTermsSubtitle.setText(R.string.terms_sale_subtitle);
            if (tvVerifiedBadge != null) tvVerifiedBadge.setText(R.string.verified_property_badge);
            if (tvContactLabel != null) tvContactLabel.setText(R.string.contact_seller);
        } else {
            btnApplyToRent.setText(R.string.btn_schedule_viewing_action);
            if (tvTermsSubtitle != null) tvTermsSubtitle.setText(R.string.terms_rent_subtitle);
            if (tvVerifiedBadge != null) tvVerifiedBadge.setText(R.string.verified_rental_badge);
            if (tvContactLabel != null) tvContactLabel.setText(R.string.contact_caretaker);
        }

        btnApplyToRent.setOnClickListener(v -> showActionOptions());
    }

    private void showActionOptions() {
        String[] options;
        if (isForSale) {
            options = new String[]{
                    getString(R.string.btn_book_site_visit),
                    getString(R.string.btn_make_offer)
            };
        } else {
            options = new String[]{
                    getString(R.string.btn_schedule_viewing),
                    getString(R.string.btn_apply_to_rent)
            };
        }

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(propertyName.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.app_name) : propertyName)
                .setItems(options, (dialog, which) -> {
                    if (which == 0) {
                        showScheduleViewingDialog();
                    } else {
                        showApplicationBottomSheet();
                    }
                })
                .show();
    }

    private void showScheduleViewingDialog() {
        Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();

        new DatePickerDialog(
                this,
                (view, year, month, dayOfMonth) -> {
                    String selectedDate = String.format(
                            Locale.getDefault(),
                            "%04d-%02d-%02d",
                            year, month + 1, dayOfMonth
                    );
                    showTimeSlotPicker(selectedDate);
                },
                cal.get(Calendar.YEAR),
                cal.get(Calendar.MONTH),
                cal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        ).show();
    }

    private void showTimeSlotPicker(String viewingDate) {
        String[] timeSlots = {
                "Morning (09:00 - 11:00)",
                "Midday (11:00 - 13:00)",
                "Afternoon (14:00 - 16:00)",
                "Late Afternoon (16:00 - 18:00)"
        };

        String title = isForSale ? "Select Site Inspection Time" : "Select Viewing Time";

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(title)
                .setItems(timeSlots, (dialog, which) -> {
                    String fullViewingSlot = viewingDate + " " + timeSlots[which];
                    submitViewingToSupabase(fullViewingSlot);
                })
                .show();
    }

    private void submitViewingToSupabase(String formattedViewingTime) {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            showFormError(R.string.please_log_in_to_save);
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/viewings", "POST", accessToken);

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("tenant_uid", userId);
                body.put("landlord_uid", landlordUid);
                body.put("listing_id", listingId);
                body.put("property_name", propertyName);
                body.put("location", locationText);
                body.put("viewing_date", formattedViewingTime);
                body.put("status", "Pending Host");

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        String successMsg = isForSale
                                ? "Site inspection requested! Check your Viewings tab."
                                : "Viewing requested! Check your Viewings tab.";
                        Toast.makeText(this, successMsg, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Could not submit appointment. Please try again.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Schedule viewing error", e);
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, "Network error requesting appointment.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showApplicationBottomSheet() {
        BottomSheetDialog dialog = new BottomSheetDialog(this);
        dialog.setContentView(R.layout.dialog_apply_rental);

        ImageButton btnCloseDialog = dialog.findViewById(R.id.btnCloseDialog);
        TextView dialogTitle = dialog.findViewById(R.id.dialogPropertyTitle);
        EditText etApplicantName = dialog.findViewById(R.id.etApplicantName);
        EditText etIdNumber = dialog.findViewById(R.id.etIdNumber);
        EditText etPhone = dialog.findViewById(R.id.etPhone);
        EditText etEmergencyContact = dialog.findViewById(R.id.etEmergencyContact);
        Spinner spinnerOccupation = dialog.findViewById(R.id.spinnerOccupation);
        TextView tvSelectedMoveInDate = dialog.findViewById(R.id.tvSelectedMoveInDate);
        Spinner spinnerLeaseDuration = dialog.findViewById(R.id.spinnerLeaseDuration);
        Spinner spinnerOccupants = dialog.findViewById(R.id.spinnerOccupants);
        EditText etTenantNote = dialog.findViewById(R.id.etTenantNote);
        CheckBox cbAcceptTerms = dialog.findViewById(R.id.cbAcceptTerms);
        Button btnSubmit = dialog.findViewById(R.id.btnSubmitApplication);

        if (dialogTitle != null) {
            String title = isForSale
                    ? "Offer / Purchase Enquiry"
                    : getString(R.string.application_dialog_title, propertyName, priceText);
            dialogTitle.setText(title);
        }

        if (btnCloseDialog != null) {
            btnCloseDialog.setOnClickListener(v -> new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle(R.string.dialog_discard_title)
                    .setMessage(R.string.dialog_discard_message)
                    .setPositiveButton(R.string.dialog_btn_discard, (d, which) -> dialog.dismiss())
                    .setNegativeButton(R.string.dialog_btn_continue, null)
                    .show());
        }

        final String[] chosenDate = { getString(R.string.default_move_in_date) };

        if (tvSelectedMoveInDate != null) {
            tvSelectedMoveInDate.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();
                new DatePickerDialog(
                        this,
                        (view, year, month, dayOfMonth) -> {
                            chosenDate[0] = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%02d/%02d/%d", dayOfMonth, month + 1, year);
                            tvSelectedMoveInDate.setText(chosenDate[0]);
                        },
                        cal.get(Calendar.YEAR),
                        cal.get(Calendar.MONTH),
                        cal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
                ).show();
            });
        }

        if (btnSubmit != null) {
            if (isForSale) {
                btnSubmit.setText("Submit Purchase Offer");
            }

            btnSubmit.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                String name = etApplicantName != null ? etApplicantName.getText().toString().trim() : "";
                String idNum = etIdNumber != null ? etIdNumber.getText().toString().trim() : "";
                String phone = etPhone != null ? etPhone.getText().toString().trim() : "";
                String emergency = etEmergencyContact != null ? etEmergencyContact.getText().toString().trim() : "";

                if (name.isEmpty()) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_name);
                    return;
                }

                if (idNum.length() != 13) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_id);
                    return;
                }

                if (phone.length() != 10 || !phone.startsWith("0")) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_phone);
                    return;
                }

                if (emergency.length() != 10 || !emergency.startsWith("0")) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_emergency);
                    return;
                }

                if (cbAcceptTerms != null && !cbAcceptTerms.isChecked()) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_accept_terms);
                    return;
                }

                String occupation = (spinnerOccupation != null && spinnerOccupation.getSelectedItem() != null)
                        ? spinnerOccupation.getSelectedItem().toString()
                        : getString(R.string.default_occupation);

                String duration = (spinnerLeaseDuration != null && spinnerLeaseDuration.getSelectedItem() != null)
                        ? spinnerLeaseDuration.getSelectedItem().toString()
                        : getString(R.string.default_lease_duration);

                String occupants = (spinnerOccupants != null && spinnerOccupants.getSelectedItem() != null)
                        ? spinnerOccupants.getSelectedItem().toString()
                        : getString(R.string.default_occupants);

                String note = (etTenantNote != null && !etTenantNote.getText().toString().trim().isEmpty())
                        ? etTenantNote.getText().toString().trim()
                        : getString(R.string.default_tenant_note);

                submitRentalApplicationToSupabase(
                        dialog,
                        btnSubmit,
                        name,
                        phone,
                        emergency,
                        occupation,
                        chosenDate[0],
                        duration,
                        occupants,
                        note
                );
            });
        }

        dialog.show();
    }

    private void submitRentalApplicationToSupabase(
            BottomSheetDialog dialog,
            Button btnSubmit,
            String name,
            String phone,
            String emergency,
            String occupation,
            String moveInDate,
            String duration,
            String occupants,
            String note
    ) {
        String tenantUid = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (tenantUid == null || tenantUid.trim().isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null || accessToken.trim().isEmpty()
                || listingId == null || listingId.trim().isEmpty()
                || landlordUid == null || landlordUid.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.rental_application_missing_details, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        btnSubmit.setEnabled(false);
        btnSubmit.setText("Submitting...");

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("listing_id", listingId);
                body.put("landlord_uid", landlordUid);
                body.put("tenant_uid", tenantUid);
                body.put("applicant_name", name);
                body.put("phone", phone);
                body.put("emergency_contact", emergency);
                body.put("occupation", occupation);
                body.put("move_in_date", moveInDate);
                body.put("lease_duration", duration);
                body.put("occupants", occupants);
                body.put("note", note);
                body.put("status", "PENDING");

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/rental_applications", "POST", accessToken);
                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                Log.d(TAG, "Rental application HTTP " + responseCode + ": " + response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        dialog.dismiss();
                        Toast.makeText(this, R.string.rental_application_sent, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();

                        if (btnApplyToRent != null) {
                            btnApplyToRent.setText(R.string.btn_pending_review);
                            btnApplyToRent.setEnabled(false);
                            btnApplyToRent.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.GRAY));
                        }
                    } else {
                        btnSubmit.setEnabled(true);
                        btnSubmit.setText(isForSale ? "Submit Purchase Offer" : getString(R.string.btn_apply_to_rent));
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Application failed (HTTP " + responseCode + "). Check Logcat.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Rental application submission failed", e);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    btnSubmit.setEnabled(true);
                    btnSubmit.setText(isForSale ? "Submit Purchase Offer" : getString(R.string.btn_apply_to_rent));
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.rental_application_send_failed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showFormError(int messageResource) {
        Toast.makeText(this, messageResource, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    }

    private void setupEmbeddedMap() {
        mapView = findViewById(R.id.mapView);
        if (mapView == null) return;

        XYTileSource tileSource = new XYTileSource(
                "OpenStreetMapDE",
                0,
                19,
                256,
                ".png",
                new String[]{ "https://tile.openstreetmap.de/" },
                "Â© OpenStreetMap contributors"
        );

        mapView.setTileSource(tileSource);
        mapView.setMultiTouchControls(true);
        mapView.getController().setZoom(16.0);

        if (!Double.isNaN(verifiedLatitude) && !Double.isNaN(verifiedLongitude)) {
            plotMarkerOnMap(verifiedLatitude, verifiedLongitude);
        }
    }

    private void updateMapCoordinatesFromLocation(String location) {
        if (location == null || location.trim().isEmpty()) return;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                Geocoder geocoder = new Geocoder(this, Locale.getDefault());
                List<Address> addresses = geocoder.getFromLocationName(location, 1);

                if (addresses != null && !addresses.isEmpty()) {
                    Address address = addresses.get(0);
                    verifiedLatitude = address.getLatitude();
                    verifiedLongitude = address.getLongitude();

                    runOnUiThread(() -> plotMarkerOnMap(verifiedLatitude, verifiedLongitude));
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.w(TAG, "Could not geocode property location", e);
            }
        });
    }

    private void plotMarkerOnMap(double lat, double lon) {
        if (mapView == null) return;

        GeoPoint point = new GeoPoint(lat, lon);
        mapView.getController().setCenter(point);
        mapView.getOverlays().clear();

        Marker marker = new Marker(mapView);
        marker.setPosition(point);
        marker.setAnchor(Marker.ANCHOR_CENTER, Marker.ANCHOR_BOTTOM);
        marker.setTitle(propertyName.isEmpty() ? "Property Location" : propertyName);
        marker.setSnippet(locationText);
        marker.setIcon(ContextCompat.getDrawable(this, org.osmdroid.library.R.drawable.marker_default));

        mapView.getOverlays().add(marker);
        mapView.invalidate();
    }

    private void launchTurnByTurnNavigation() {
        if (Double.isNaN(verifiedLatitude) || Double.isNaN(verifiedLongitude)
                || Double.isInfinite(verifiedLatitude) || Double.isInfinite(verifiedLongitude)) {
            openLocationInMaps(true);
            return;
        }

        Uri navigationUri = Uri.parse("google.navigation:q=" + verifiedLatitude + "," + verifiedLongitude + "&mode=d");
        Intent navigationIntent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, navigationUri);
        navigationIntent.setPackage("com.google.android.apps.maps");

        if (navigationIntent.resolveActivity(getPackageManager()) != null) {
            startActivity(navigationIntent);
        } else {
            Uri fallbackUri = Uri.parse(String.format(Locale.ENGLISH, "geo:%f,%f?q=%f,%f",
                    verifiedLatitude, verifiedLongitude, verifiedLatitude, verifiedLongitude));
            startActivity(new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, fallbackUri));
        }
    }

    private void openLocationInMaps(boolean directions) {
        if (locationText == null || locationText.trim().isEmpty()) {
            showFormError(R.string.location_not_available);
            return;
        }

        String encodedLocation = Uri.encode(locationText);
        Uri uri = directions
                ? Uri.parse("https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=" + encodedLocation)
                : Uri.parse("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=" + encodedLocation);

        try {
            startActivity(new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            showFormError(R.string.could_not_open_maps);
        }
    }

    private void loadListingFromSupabase() {
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?select=*&id=eq."
                        + URLEncoder.encode(listingId, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20")
                        + "&limit=1";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);
                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode < 200 || responseCode >= 300) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Could not load listing. HTTP " + responseCode + ": " + response);
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray listings = new JSONArray(response);
                if (listings.length() == 0) return;

                JSONObject listing = listings.getJSONObject(0);

                String imageUrl = listing.optString("image_url", "");
                String name = listing.optString("property_name", "");
                String price = listing.optString("price", "");
                String location = listing.optString("location", "");
                String description = listing.optString("description", "");
                propertyType = listing.optString("property_type", "Room");
                String offerType = listing.optString("offer_type", "rent");

                isForSale = "sale".equalsIgnoreCase(offerType)
                        || "Farm".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyType)
                        || "Vacant Land".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyType)
                        || "Land".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyType);

                landlordUid = listing.optString("landlord_uid", "");
                propertyName = clean(name);
                locationText = clean(location);
                originalDescription = clean(description);

                if (price == null || price.trim().isEmpty() || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(price.trim())) {
                    priceText = "";
                } else if (isForSale) {
                    priceText = getString(R.string.price_for_sale_value, price);
                } else {
                    priceText = getString(R.string.price_per_month_value, price);
                }

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (txtPropertyName != null) txtPropertyName.setText(propertyName);
                    if (txtPropertyPrice != null) txtPropertyPrice.setText(priceText);
                    if (txtPropertyLocation != null) txtPropertyLocation.setText(locationText);
                    if (propertyDescription != null) propertyDescription.setText(originalDescription);

                    populateChipGroup(chipGroupAmenities, listing.opt("amenities"));
                    populateChipGroup(chipGroupRules, listing.opt("rules"));

                    updateActionButtonsForOffering();

                    Locale locale = getResources().getConfiguration().getLocales().get(0);
                    if (btnTranslate != null && !"en".equals(locale.getLanguage()) && !originalDescription.trim().isEmpty()) {
                        btnTranslate.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        btnTranslate.setText(getString(R.string.translate_to_language, getLanguageDisplayName(locale.getLanguage())));
                    }
                });

                if (!clean(imageUrl).isEmpty()) {
                    loadPropertyImage(imageUrl);
                }

                double dbLat = listing.optDouble("latitude", Double.NaN);
                double dbLon = listing.optDouble("longitude", Double.NaN);

                if (!Double.isNaN(dbLat) && !Double.isNaN(dbLon)) {
                    verifiedLatitude = dbLat;
                    verifiedLongitude = dbLon;
                    runOnUiThread(() -> plotMarkerOnMap(verifiedLatitude, verifiedLongitude));
                } else {
                    updateMapCoordinatesFromLocation(location);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error loading listing details", e);
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadPropertyImage(String imageUrl) {
        if (imageUrl == null || imageUrl.trim().isEmpty() || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(imageUrl.trim())) {
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(imageUrl.trim()).openConnection();
                connection.setConnectTimeout(15000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(20000);
                connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                connection.connect();

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                    try (InputStream input = connection.getInputStream()) {
                        Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input);
                        if (bitmap != null && !isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                if (propertyImage != null) {
                                    propertyImage.setImageBitmap(bitmap);
                                    propertyImage.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not display property image", e);
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void saveListing() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            showFormError(R.string.please_log_in_to_save);
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/saved_listings", "POST", accessToken);
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("tenant_uid", userId);
                body.put("listing_id", listingId);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        showFormError(R.string.accommodation_saved);
                    } else if (responseCode == 409) {
                        showFormError(R.string.already_saved);
                    } else {
                        showFormError(R.string.could_not_save_accommodation);
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Save listing error", e);
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void contactLandlord() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            showFormError(R.string.please_log_in_to_contact_landlord);
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/enquiries", "POST", accessToken);
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("tenant_uid", userId);
                body.put("landlord_uid", landlordUid);
                body.put("listing_id", listingId);
                body.put("message", getString(R.string.default_enquiry_message));

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        showFormError(R.string.enquiry_sent);
                    } else {
                        showFormError(R.string.could_not_send_enquiry);
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Contact landlord error", e);
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private String clean(String value) {
        if (value == null || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {
            return "";
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private String getLanguageDisplayName(String code) {
        switch (code) {
            case "zu": return getString(R.string.language_isizulu);
            case "xh": return getString(R.string.language_isixhosa);
            case "st": return getString(R.string.language_sesotho);
            default: return getString(R.string.language_local);
        }
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        return Math.round(dp * density);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (mapView != null) mapView.onResume();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        if (mapView != null) mapView.onPause();
        super.onPause();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (mapView != null) mapView.onDetach();
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.RadioGroup;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

public class RegisterActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        setContentView(R.layout.activity_register);

        Button btnRegister = findViewById(R.id.btnRegister);

        RadioGroup userTypeGroup = findViewById(R.id.userTypeGroup);

        btnRegister.setOnClickListener(v -> {

            int selectedTypeId =
                    userTypeGroup.getCheckedRadioButtonId();

            // Make sure a user type is selected
            if (selectedTypeId == -1) {

                Toast.makeText(
                        RegisterActivity.this,
                        "Please select Tenant or Landlord",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show();

                return;
            }


            // LANDLORD
            if (selectedTypeId == R.id.radioLandlord) {

                Intent intent = new Intent(
                        RegisterActivity.this,
                        LandlordDashboardActivity.class
                );

                startActivity(intent);
                finish();

            else if (selectedTypeId == R.id.radioTenant) {

                Intent intent = new Intent(
                        RegisterActivity.this,
                        HomeActivity.class
                );

                startActivity(intent);
                finish();

            }

        });

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.AutoCompleteTextView;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.RelativeLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class ReportProblemActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private AutoCompleteTextView dropdownCategory;
    private EditText edtProblem;
    private Button btnSubmitProblem;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private final String[] categories = {
            "Listing Issue / Fraud",
            "Technical Bug / Crash",
            "Payment / Fee Dispute",
            "Landlord / Resident Conduct",
            "Account / Login Problem",
            "Other Support Inquiry"
    };

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_report_problem);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        dropdownCategory = findViewById(R.id.dropdownCategory);
        edtProblem = findViewById(R.id.edtProblem);
        btnSubmitProblem = findViewById(R.id.btnSubmitProblem);

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        setupCategoryDropdown();

        if (btnSubmitProblem != null) {
            btnSubmitProblem.setOnClickListener(v -> submitReport());
        }

        loadMyTickets();
    }

    private void setupCategoryDropdown() {
        if (dropdownCategory == null) return;

        ArrayAdapter<String> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(
                this,
                android.R.layout.simple_dropdown_item_1line,
                categories
        );
        dropdownCategory.setAdapter(adapter);
        dropdownCategory.setText(categories[0], false);
        dropdownCategory.setKeyListener(null);

        dropdownCategory.setOnClickListener(v -> dropdownCategory.showDropDown());
        dropdownCategory.setOnFocusChangeListener((v, hasFocus) -> {
            if (hasFocus) dropdownCategory.showDropDown();
        });
    }

    private void submitReport() {
        String category = dropdownCategory.getText().toString().trim();
        String description = edtProblem.getText().toString().trim();

        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(description)) {
            edtProblem.setError("Please describe the problem");
            edtProblem.requestFocus();
            return;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            userId = prefs.getString("USER_ID", "guest_user");
        }
        if (accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getSupabaseKey();
        }

        String userName = prefs.getString("USER_NAME", "User");
        String userRole = prefs.getString("USER_ROLE", "tenant");

        btnSubmitProblem.setEnabled(false);
        btnSubmitProblem.setText("Submitting ticket...");

        String finalUserId = userId;
        String finalAccessToken = accessToken;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                JSONObject report = new JSONObject();
                report.put("reporter_uid", finalUserId);
                report.put("reporter_name", userName);
                report.put("reporter_role", userRole);
                report.put("reason", category);
                report.put("description", description);
                report.put("status", "open");

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/reports", "POST", finalAccessToken);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, report);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String errorResponse = "";
                if (responseCode >= 400) {
                    errorResponse = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                    Log.e("ReportProblem", "HTTP " + responseCode + " - " + errorResponse);
                }

                final String finalErr = errorResponse;
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    btnSubmitProblem.setEnabled(true);
                    btnSubmitProblem.setText(R.string.submit_report);

                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        Toast.makeText(ReportProblemActivity.this, "Ticket submitted. Our team will review it.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        edtProblem.setText("");
                        loadMyTickets();
                    } else {
                        String userMsg = "Could not submit ticket (HTTP " + responseCode + ").";
                        if (finalErr.contains("row-level security") || finalErr.contains("42501")) {
                            userMsg += "\nRLS policy check failed in Supabase.";
                        }
                        Toast.makeText(ReportProblemActivity.this, userMsg, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    btnSubmitProblem.setEnabled(true);
                    btnSubmitProblem.setText(R.string.submit_report);
                    Toast.makeText(ReportProblemActivity.this, "Network error submitting ticket.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadMyTickets() {
        LinearLayout myTicketsContainer = findViewById(R.id.myTicketsContainer);
        if (myTicketsContainer == null) return;

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            return; // Can't fetch tickets if not logged in
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/reports?reporter_uid=eq." + userId + "&order=created_at.desc",
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    runOnUiThread(() -> displayMyTickets(arr, myTicketsContainer));
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e("ReportProblem", "Error fetching tickets: " + e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void displayMyTickets(JSONArray arr, LinearLayout container) {
        container.removeAllViews();
        if (arr.length() == 0) {
            TextView emptyMsg = new TextView(this);
            emptyMsg.setText("You haven't submitted any tickets.");
            emptyMsg.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
            container.addView(emptyMsg);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            try {
                JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                String reason = obj.optString("reason", "Issue");
                String desc = obj.optString("description", "");
                String status = obj.optString("status", "OPEN").toUpperCase();
                String adminResponse = obj.optString("admin_response", "");

                CardView card = new CardView(this);
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams cardParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );
                cardParams.setMargins(0, 0, 0, 24);
                card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);
                card.setRadius(16f);
                card.setCardElevation(2f);
                card.setCardBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE);

                LinearLayout layout = new LinearLayout(this);
                layout.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                layout.setPadding(32, 28, 32, 28);

                // Header Row
                RelativeLayout header = new RelativeLayout(this);
                TextView tvReason = new TextView(this);
                tvReason.setText(reason);
                tvReason.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BA5536"));
                tvReason.setTextSize(15f);
                tvReason.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
                header.addView(tvReason);

                TextView tvStatus = new TextView(this);
                tvStatus.setText(status);
                tvStatus.setTextSize(11f);
                tvStatus.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
                RelativeLayout.LayoutParams statusParams = new RelativeLayout.LayoutParams(
                        RelativeLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                        RelativeLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );
                statusParams.addRule(RelativeLayout.ALIGN_PARENT_END);
                tvStatus.setLayoutParams(statusParams);
                
                if (status.equalsIgnoreCase("RESOLVED")) {
                    tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#007749"));
                    tvStatus.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#E6F4EA"));
                } else if (status.equalsIgnoreCase("DISMISSED")) {
                    tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
                    tvStatus.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#EAEAEA"));
                } else {
                    tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
                }
                header.addView(tvStatus);
                layout.addView(header);

                // Original Description
                TextView tvDesc = new TextView(this);
                tvDesc.setText("You: " + desc);
                tvDesc.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#495057"));
                tvDesc.setTextSize(13f);
                tvDesc.setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8);
                layout.addView(tvDesc);

                // Admin Response (if exists)
                if (!adminResponse.isEmpty() && !adminResponse.equals("null")) {
                    View divider = new View(this);
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams divParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            2 // 2px or 1dp
                    );
                    divParams.setMargins(0, 12, 0, 12);
                    divider.setLayoutParams(divParams);
                    divider.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#F0EBE6"));
                    layout.addView(divider);

                    TextView tvResponse = new TextView(this);
                    tvResponse.setText("Admin: " + adminResponse);
                    tvResponse.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
                    tvResponse.setTextSize(13f);
                    tvResponse.setTypeface(null, Typeface.ITALIC);
                    layout.addView(tvResponse);
                }

                card.addView(layout);
                container.addView(card);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView;
import androidx.coordinatorlayout.widget.CoordinatorLayout;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.InputStream;

public class SavedListingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private LinearLayout savedListingsContainer;
    private View txtNoSavedListings;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4);

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_saved_listings);

        savedListingsContainer = findViewById(R.id.savedListingsContainer);
        txtNoSavedListings = findViewById(R.id.txtNoSavedListings);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        View btnEmptyExplore = findViewById(R.id.btnEmptyExplore);
        if (btnEmptyExplore != null) {
            btnEmptyExplore.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        loadSavedListings();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (savedListingsContainer != null) {

        }
    }

    private void setupBottomNavigation() {
        View savedRoot = findViewById(R.id.savedRoot);
        View floatingBottomNav = findViewById(R.id.floatingBottomNav);

        if (floatingBottomNav != null) {
            floatingBottomNav.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);

            if (savedRoot != null) {
                ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(savedRoot, (v, insets) -> {
                    Insets statusBar = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars());
                    Insets navBar = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.navigationBars());

                    v.setPadding(0, statusBar.top, 0, 0);

                    if (floatingBottomNav.getLayoutParams() instanceof CoordinatorLayout.LayoutParams) {
                        CoordinatorLayout.LayoutParams lp = (CoordinatorLayout.LayoutParams) floatingBottomNav.getLayoutParams();
                        int baseMarginPx = dpToPx(16);
                        lp.bottomMargin = navBar.bottom + baseMarginPx;
                        floatingBottomNav.setLayoutParams(lp);
                        floatingBottomNav.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
                    }

                    return WindowInsetsCompat.CONSUMED;
                });
            }

            // Tab 1: Discover
            View navHome = findViewById(R.id.navHome);
            if (navHome != null) {
                navHome.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    Intent intent = new Intent(SavedListingsActivity.this, HomeActivity.class);
                    intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP);
                    startActivity(intent);
                    finish();
                });
            }

            // Tab 3: Viewings
            View navViewings = findViewById(R.id.navViewings);
            if (navViewings != null) {
                navViewings.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    startActivity(new Intent(SavedListingsActivity.this, ViewingsActivity.class));
                    finish();
                });
            }

            // Tab 4: Messages
            View navMessages = findViewById(R.id.navMessages);
            if (navMessages != null) {
                navMessages.setOnClickListener(v ->
                        startActivity(new Intent(SavedListingsActivity.this, UserSelectionActivity.class))
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void loadSavedListings() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/saved_listings"
                        + "?select=*"
                        + "&tenant_uid=eq."
                        + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                        + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    showMessage("Could not load favorites.");
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray savedRows = new JSONArray(response);
                List<JSONObject> result = new ArrayList<>();

                for (int i = 0; i < savedRows.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject saved = savedRows.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (saved == null) continue;

                    String listingId = firstValue(saved, "listing_id", "property_id");
                    if (listingId.isEmpty()) continue;

                    JSONObject property = fetchListing(listingId, token);
                    if (property != null) {
                        property.put("_saved_listing_id", saved.optString("id", ""));
                        property.put("_saved_listing_listing_id", listingId);
                        result.add(property);
                    }
                }

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    savedListingsContainer.removeAllViews();

                    if (result.isEmpty()) {
                        if (txtNoSavedListings != null) {
                            txtNoSavedListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    if (txtNoSavedListings != null) {
                        txtNoSavedListings.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    }

                    for (JSONObject property : result) {
                        addListingCard(property, userId);
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage("Could not load favorites. Please try again.");
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private JSONObject fetchListing(String listingId, String token) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings"
                    + "?select=*"
                    + "&id=eq."
                    + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId)
                    + "&limit=1";

            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code < 200 || code >= 300) return null;

            JSONArray rows = new JSONArray(response);
            return rows.length() == 0 ? null : rows.optJSONObject(0);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
    }

    private void addListingCard(JSONObject property, String userId) {
        String listingId = firstValue(property, "_saved_listing_listing_id", "id");
        String savedRowId = firstValue(property, "_saved_listing_id");

                        )

        );

    private void removeFavorite(String listingId, String savedRowId, String userId) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/saved_listings?tenant_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

                if (!savedRowId.isEmpty()) {
                    endpoint += "&id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(savedRowId);
                } else {
                    endpoint += "&listing_id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId);
                }

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "DELETE", token);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    showMessage("Favorite removed.");
                    loadSavedListings();
                } else {
                    showMessage("Could not remove favorite. Supabase error: " + code);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage("Could not remove favorite. Please try again.");
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadImage(String imageUrl, ImageView imageView) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                if (!imageUrl.startsWith("https://") && !imageUrl.startsWith("http://")) return;

                connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(imageUrl).openConnection();
                connection.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(15000);
                connection.connect();

                if (connection.getResponseCode() < 200 || connection.getResponseCode() >= 300) return;

                try (InputStream input = connection.getInputStream()) {
                    Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input);
                    if (bitmap != null) {
                        runOnUiThread(() -> {
                            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                                imageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private String firstValue(JSONObject object, String... keys) {
        for (String key : keys) {
            Object raw = object.opt(key);
            if (raw == null || raw == JSONObject.NULL) continue;

            String value = String.valueOf(raw).trim();
            if (!value.isEmpty() && !value.equalsIgnoreCase("null")) {
                return value;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        return Math.round(dp * density);
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() ->
                Toast.makeText(SavedListingsActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void updateChipSelection(Button selectedChip) {

        for (Button chip : allChips) {

    private void triggerNewSearch() {
        if (searchBox != null) {
            currentSearchQuery = searchBox.getText().toString().trim();
        }
        executeSearch();
    }

    private void executeSearch() {
        if (searchResultsContainer != null) {
            searchResultsContainer.removeAllViews();
        }
        if (txtNoResults != null) {
            txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                StringBuilder endpoint = new StringBuilder("/rest/v1/listings?select=*");

                // Hide pending moderation listings
                endpoint.append("&status=neq.pending");

                if (!currentSearchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                    String enc = SupabaseHelper.encode(currentSearchQuery);
                    endpoint.append("&or=(property_name.ilike.*").append(enc)
                            .append("*,location.ilike.*").append(enc).append("*)");
                }

                if (!currentPropertyType.isEmpty()) {
                    endpoint.append("&property_type=ilike.*").append(SupabaseHelper.encode(currentPropertyType)).append("*");
                }

                endpoint.append("&order=created_at.desc&limit=50");

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint.toString(), "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray results = new JSONArray(response);

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                        if (results.length() == 0) {
                            if (txtNoResults != null) txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        } else {
                            if (txtNoResults != null) txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                            for (int i = 0; i < results.length(); i++) {
                                JSONObject item = results.optJSONObject(i);
                                if (item != null) {
                                    addListingCard(item);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (txtNoResults != null) {
                            txtNoResults.setText("Unable to load listings right now.");
                            txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (txtNoResults != null) {
                        txtNoResults.setText("Network error. Please check your connection.");
                        txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    }
                });
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import okhttp3.MediaType;
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient;
import okhttp3.Request;
import okhttp3.RequestBody;
import okhttp3.Response;

public class SupabaseHelper {

    private static final String SUPABASE_URL =
            "https://wdtazumjjurumrhklwgv.supabase.co";

    private static final String SUPABASE_KEY =
            "sb_publishable_SgXZRNFBL4tswVtapc3pFQ_qpD-DijB";

    private static final OkHttpClient httpClient = new OkHttpClient();

    public static String getSupabaseUrl() {
        return SUPABASE_URL;
    }

    public static String getSupabaseKey() {
        return SUPABASE_KEY;
    }

    public static String getAccessToken(Context context) {
        return context
                .getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getString("access_token", null);
    }

    public static String getUserId(Context context) {
        return context
                .getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getString("user_id", null);
    }

    public static void clearSession(Context context) {
        context
                .getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .clear()
                .apply();
    }

    /**
     * Executes a true HTTP PATCH request using OkHttp.
     * Safely handles developer bypass by omitting invalid Bearer headers when no user session exists.
     */
    public static void patch(String endpoint, JSONObject body, String accessToken) throws Exception {
        String finalUrl = endpoint.startsWith("http")
                ? endpoint
                : SUPABASE_URL + (endpoint.startsWith("/") ? endpoint : "/" + endpoint);

        MediaType mediaType = MediaType.get("application/json; charset=utf-8");
        RequestBody requestBody = RequestBody.create(body.toString(), mediaType);

        Request.Builder builder = new Request.Builder()
                .url(finalUrl)
                .addHeader("apikey", SUPABASE_KEY)
                .addHeader("Prefer", "return=minimal")
                .patch(requestBody);

        // Only send Authorization header if we have a real JWT session token (starts with 'ey')
        if (accessToken != null && accessToken.startsWith("ey")) {
            builder.addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken);
        }

        try (Response response = httpClient.newCall(builder.build()).execute()) {
            if (!response.isSuccessful()) {
                String err = response.body() != null ? response.body().string() : "";
                throw new Exception("HTTP " + response.code() + ": " + err);
            }
        }
    }

    public static HttpURLConnection createConnection(
            String endpoint,
            String method,
            String accessToken
    ) throws Exception {

        String finalUrl = endpoint.startsWith("http")
                ? endpoint
                : SUPABASE_URL + (endpoint.startsWith("/") ? endpoint : "/" + endpoint);

        URL url = new URL(finalUrl);
        HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();

        connection.setRequestMethod(method);
        connection.setRequestProperty("apikey", SUPABASE_KEY);

        if (accessToken != null && accessToken.startsWith("ey")) {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken);
        } else {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + SUPABASE_KEY);
        }

        connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");

        connection.setConnectTimeout(15000);
        connection.setReadTimeout(20000);

        if ("POST".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "PUT".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "DELETE".equalsIgnoreCase(method)) {
            connection.setDoOutput(true);
        }

        return connection;
    }

    public static HttpURLConnection createStorageConnection(
            String bucket,
            String imagePath,
            String method,
            String accessToken
    ) throws Exception {

        String safePath = imagePath.replace(" ", "%20");
        String finalUrl = SUPABASE_URL + "/storage/v1/object/" + bucket + "/" + safePath;

        URL url = new URL(finalUrl);
        HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();

        connection.setRequestMethod(method);
        connection.setRequestProperty("apikey", SUPABASE_KEY);

        if (accessToken != null && accessToken.startsWith("ey")) {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken);
        } else {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + SUPABASE_KEY);
        }

        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");
        connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream");

        connection.setConnectTimeout(15000);
        connection.setReadTimeout(30000);

        if ("POST".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "PUT".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "DELETE".equalsIgnoreCase(method)) {
            connection.setDoOutput(true);
        }

        return connection;
    }

    public static String getPublicStorageUrl(String bucket, String imagePath) {
        String safePath = imagePath.replace(" ", "%20");
        return SUPABASE_URL + "/storage/v1/object/public/" + bucket + "/" + safePath;
    }

    public static String readResponse(HttpURLConnection connection) {
        try {
            InputStream inputStream;
            int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();

            if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 400) {
                inputStream = connection.getInputStream();
            } else {
                inputStream = connection.getErrorStream();
                if (inputStream == null) {
                    return "HTTP Error " + responseCode;
                }
            }

            BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                    new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
            );

            StringBuilder response = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                response.append(line);
            }
            reader.close();

            return response.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "Connection error: " + e.getMessage();
        }
    }

    public static void writeJson(HttpURLConnection connection, JSONObject json) throws Exception {
        connection.setDoOutput(true);
        byte[] data = json.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        try (OutputStream outputStream = connection.getOutputStream()) {
            outputStream.write(data);
            outputStream.flush();
        }
    }

    public static String encode(String value) {
        try {
            return URLEncoder.encode(value, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return value;
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\TenantNotificationState.java ===


package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public final class TenantNotificationState {

    private static final String PREFS = "ikhaya_tenant_notification_v2";

    private TenantNotificationState() {
    }

    private static String key(String userId, String kind) {
        return userId + "_" + kind;
    }

    private static Set<String> getIds(JSONArray rows, String kind) {
        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();

        if (rows == null) {
            return ids;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

            if (row == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String id = row.optString("id", "");

            if (id.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            if ("applications".equals(kind)) {
                String status = row.optString("status", "");
                ids.add(id + ":" + status.toUpperCase());
            } else {
                ids.add(id);
            }
        }

        return ids;
    }

    public static synchronized boolean hasNew(
            Context context,
            String userId,
            String kind,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREFS,
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String storageKey = key(userId, kind);
        Set<String> current = getIds(rows, kind);

        if (!prefs.contains(storageKey)) {
            prefs.edit()
                    .putStringSet(storageKey, new HashSet<>(current))
                    .commit();

            return false;
        }

        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>(
                prefs.getStringSet(
                        storageKey,
                        new HashSet<>()
                )
        );

        for (String id : current) {
            if (!seen.contains(id)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static synchronized void markSeen(
            Context context,
            String userId,
            String kind,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREFS,
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String storageKey = key(userId, kind);

        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>(
                prefs.getStringSet(
                        storageKey,
                        new HashSet<>()
                )
        );

        seen.addAll(getIds(rows, kind));

        prefs.edit()
                .putStringSet(storageKey, seen)
                .commit();
    }
}
